If you’re someone who likes variety in your day, takes pride in supporting your team, and wants to grow in a manufacturing environment—this is your opportunity.

title: HPC Applications & Performance Engineer
description:
HPC Applications & Performance EngineerThis role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

HPE is seeking an experienced HPC performance engineer who is excited to help drive the performance of systems used to solve the world’s biggest problems. As a member of the HPC and AI Solutions and Performance Engineering team, this engineer will benchmark, profile, and tune HPC and AI related applications along with industry-standard benchmarks across HPE’s HPC and AI product portfolio to identify, analyze, and resolve engineering and customer issues. This engineer will have the opportunity to collaborate with leading scientists and engineers, contributing to groundbreaking innovation in HPC and AI. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical capability in HPC scientific applications, performance analysis, and HPC architecture, along with a commitment to advancing the performance of HPE supercomputers deployed at customer sites worldwide.

This role is based in Bloomington, MN or Spring, TX

This position will support government accounts. Therefore, due to federal export-control regulations, the selected candidate must hold U.S. citizenship, U.S. lawful permanent resident/Green Card status or otherwise have a category of refugee/asylee status enabling them to perform the role without requiring a license under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) or Export Administration Regulations (EAR).

Responsibilities

  • Provide pre- and post-sales technical and benchmarking support to enable HPC or AI customer opportunities

  • Collaborate with HPE product engineering, product management, and marketing to influence current and future product capabilities and direction

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their impact on product differentiation (performance and features) for key customer applications

  • Develop and maintain current knowledge of HPE and competitor HPC/AI products and performance optimization techniques to ensure the team continues to deliver high-quality benchmark results

  • Lead application-focused performance studies and projects, and author technical reports and papers that communicate findings and recommendations

Needed qualifications:

  • Bachelors, Master’s or PhD degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or equivalent

  • 7+ years of demonstrated experience with high-end HPC systems and performance analysis/tuning of scalable HPC applications

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery of English required

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with large-scale HPC systems and software

  • Experience with large-scale AI systems and software is preferred

  • Detailed understanding of multiprocessor and GPU hardware architectures, capabilities, and parallel programming techniques (e.g., OpenMP, MPI, CUDA, HIP)

  • Proficiency with key industry-standard HPC benchmarks (e.g., HPL, HPCG, OSU MPI, NCCL/RCCL) on CPUs and GPUs is preferred

  • Experience with performance projection methodologies to model performance of alternate system architectures using performance measurement tools and techniques is preferred

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected:

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

In particular, the key initial priority is to lead on recording all transactions of PF in respective accounting software as set policies and procedures. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Hi 👋 — I'm Pavlos Kallis, Head of Engineering at Douleutaras (YourHero). We're looking for a senior backend engineer who wants to own hard problems end-to-end, cares more about the person on the other side of the code than about the ticket, and leaves our systems better than they found them.

We're a tech-enabled company disrupting home services — a €6 Trillion global market where less than 5% is online. Since 2015 we've helped 1,000,000+ customers across Greece, Cyprus, and Ireland find the right professional. Our 18,000+ active pros have earned €100m+ through the platform, we've collected 250,000+ reviews, and we hold an NPS of 75+. We're backed by top-tier European investors.

What you'll actually work on

No adjectives — here's the range of problems our engineering team owns, drawn straight from what we've shipped this year:

  • The matching & bidding engine. When a customer posts a job, we decide which professionals see it, in what order, and how they bid for it — the ranking, pro-scoring (refreshed hourly), and Extra Bids systems behind "who gets this job." Flood a good pro or starve a customer of offers and the marketplace breaks.
  • Money that has to be right. Online payments, pro subscriptions, cashback and bonuses, promo codes, VAT in quotes — moving money between customers, pros, and us across three countries and currencies, wired into Stripe and our Softone ERP.
  • Keeping it fast and boring while it grows. We migrated the whole platform onto Kubernetes and run platform-wide performance epics. You'll help keep a zero-downtime system quick and unexciting to operate — the highest compliment infrastructure can earn.

And around all of that: trust & safety, a healthy experimentation culture (real A/B/C tests on live funnels), Salesforce/CRM integrations, and an AI stack (FastAPI + LangGraph agents doing RAG over pgvector). It's a broad surface; you won't run out of interesting problems.

How we work

You'll join our engineering squad — one tight, cross-functional team: 2 backend, 2 frontend, 1 mobile, 1 QA, 2 PMs, and a designer — working from a shared roadmap. You sit close to the whole product, not in a backend silo. In practice:

  • You ship to production continuously through a rock-solid GitLab CI → ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts GitOps pipeline. Deploys are boring on purpose.
  • You own features end-to-end — design, build, test, monitor — and you're trusted to make technical calls in your area.
  • We review each other's code seriously and hold a high bar. Refactoring is expected, not begrudged.
  • We pair, we write things down, and we help each other across disciplines.

AI-assisted development

AI-assisted coding is a normal part of how we build here, not a novelty. We give engineers access to tools like Claude Code. What we care about is judgment: you use it to move faster on the mechanical parts, and you review what it produces as critically as any teammate's code. We don't measure you by how much AI you use — and "the AI wrote it" is never an excuse for code you don't understand or can't stand behind.

Why you should — or shouldn't — apply

I'd rather you self-select honestly than be surprised in month two.

You'll thrive here if:

  • You can't stand corporate bureaucracy. We're one small team that moves fast with minimal process — few meetings, a short path from idea to production, and no red tape between you and shipping.
  • You take ownership of ambiguous, high-stakes problems. You build the right abstraction, not just the requested change.
  • You care deeply about correctness and data. When money and a pro's livelihood ride on your code, "it seems to work" isn't enough. You reach for tests, metrics, and EXPLAIN plans.
  • You balance speed and quality. We ship fast, but we're not cowboys — we've earned trust by being reliable.
  • You communicate with candor and welcome direct feedback without getting defensive.
  • You act like an owner — accountable, goal-oriented, and generous with teammates.

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • You picture "senior / staff / lead" as mostly reviewing designs and signing off on architecture. Our most experienced engineers spend most of their time building — we hand them our hardest problems. They set technical direction and help others plan the tough work, but that's earned influence, not a gate: nobody needs their sign-off to ship.
  • You lose the forest for the trees. Once you're deep in implementation it's hard for you to zoom back out to the whole project — and you'd rather everything be specced upfront than adjust as you learn.
  • You haven't owned a project end-to-end. You're most comfortable when a tech lead slices the work into tickets and hands them over. Here you take a problem brief and drive it yourself.
  • You want only greenfield work. Real systems mean production incidents, legacy corners (we're retiring an old Angular frontend and some Gulp tooling), and customer investigations shared across the team.

Our tech stack

We care about fundamentals over stack familiarity; how you think and how fast you learn matter far more than years-in-Django.

  • Backend: Python 3.10, Django 4.2, DRF, UV, Docker
  • Data: PostgreSQL 14 / PostGIS, Elasticsearch 7.x, Redis, Memcached
  • Async: Celery on RabbitMQ
  • AI: FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI + Anthropic (Claude), pgvector
  • Frontend (adjacent): React, TypeScript, Flutter/Dart
  • Platform: Kubernetes (EKS) on AWS, Terraform, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts, Cloudflare
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, New Relic, Sentry, PostHog

Requirements

What we'd love you to bring

  • 5+ years building and scaling production backend services, with strong Python / Django and REST API depth.
  • You've designed systems, not just implemented tickets — you define service and API boundaries, weigh architectural trade-offs, and can explain why you chose one over another.
  • Real PostgreSQL depth at scale — data modeling, query optimization, indexing, and keeping correctness under concurrency (this is a money-handling marketplace).
  • Asynchronous / distributed systems experience — background processing, queues (Celery or similar), and a healthy respect for their failure modes.
  • You own what you ship in production — comfortable with observability, debugging live incidents, and treating tests as part of the work, not an afterthought.
  • Experience leading projects end-to-end and lifting the engineers around you — technical direction, serious code review, mentoring by example.
  • Comfort with Docker + Kubernetes, a major cloud (AWS preferred), and CI/CD;
  • Excellent English and interest in joining a remote, multicultural team.

Bonus points: Terraform (IaC) · FastAPI · LLM & agentic experience (LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, pgvector) · payments/fintech or marketplace background · a startup or high-performance-team environment.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and potential stock options
  • Group Health Insurance
  • The workstation of your choice
  • A bespoke development plan to grow fast and reach your potential
  • The genuine ownership of impacting millions of customers and thousands of pros — on an international team that works hard and has fun doing it

description:
Under the direction of the WJP Employment & Education (EE) Program Supervisor, the WJP EE Specialist is responsible for advancing education and employment opportunities for program clients. This will include coordinating and delivering client training and support on a broad range of education, employment and career- oriented services, data management, and becoming part of the treatment team. Position also requires networking and marketing skills as well as ability to build relationships with potential employers and education partners.

PROGRAM SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Career Guidance and Counseling

  • • Engage clients and establish trusting, collaborative relationships in order to provide individualized support and develop vocational plans according to clients’ specific needs and preferences while incorporating input from the treatment team, family members and other designated persons with the clients’ consent.
  • • Conduct education and career assessments, proficiency testing and interest inventories with justice-involved clients and program graduates to develop an inventory of clients’ strengths, needs, abilities, and preferences.
  • • Implement trauma-informed care practices and individualized plan.
  • • Assess and respond to emergent signs of risk and suicidality.
  • • Link clients to appropriate intra-agency and community resources to promote wellness and recovery, and collaborate with treatment team to ensure clients’ services are integrated.
  • • Work one-on-one and in groups on job development, resume skills, conflict resolution, customer service, communication, and the necessary soft skills for job readiness/retention.
  • • Link clients to job fairs and career trade shows to expand employment opportunities.
  • • Support clients by linking with the most appropriate employment setting and maintain regular touch points with participant and business partner.
  • • Provide individual and group career guidance and coaching, and case management focused on helping clients prepare for employment that leads to long-term self-sufficiency.
  • • Provide follow-along support to increase retention, client success, and employer satisfaction.
  • • Maintain employment and education data for the clients including pay stubs, schedules, resumes, employment history, banking information and general work attendance for current participants, program graduates and WJT clients.
  • • Advocate for criminal justice involved clients participating in court-ordered or voluntary treatment.
  • • Utilize health information technology and electronic interventions including mobile and web-based technologies.
  • • Demonstrate and utilize knowledge of client population and proven practices related to the treatment of alcohol and other substance use disorders, co-occurring, and mental health interventions.

Coordinating and Delivering Client Training

  • • Coordinate supported educational opportunities, including GED courses, post-secondary schooling and or specialized skill/trade courses.
  • • Provide skill-based education to clients on topics such as interviewing, attendance, and performance, and provide or link to counseling on money budgeting and employment benefits.
  • • Implement best-practice curriculums and other relevant emerging bodies of knowledge to produce improved education and employment outcomes.
  • • Assist clients in determining the objectives needed to reach their recovery goals.
  • • Utilize best practices for individual and group education sessions.
  • • Work to increase client engagement through structure, incentives, individualization of service offerings, and robust support network.
  • • Develop partnerships within the community and assist with education and career placement and retention.
  • • Provide partner support between the educator and/or employer and client to ensure needs are met and increase client outcomes.
  • • Perform a variety of programmatic and administrative customer-centered tasks including current and potential partner outreach.
  • • Advocate for participants in the community.
  • • Expand partnerships through other service providers and volunteers to strengthen employment interventions and support.
  • • Promote wellness, self-care, and self-advocacy; teach clients how to practice positive self-talk; and demonstrate problem-solving techniques to clients.

Networking and Relationship Building with Potential Employers

  • • Conduct employment search activities and build ongoing collaborative relationships with area employers directed toward the individualized vocational plans of assigned clients to assist with job placement and retention.
  • • Provide Human Resource support between the employer and employee to ensure needs are met and serve as a liaison between individuals, their employers and community agencies.
  • • Perform a variety of programmatic and administrative customer-centered tasks including customer outreach.
  • • Advocate for participants in the business community.
  • • Work with supervisor to establish contact with community partners and external referral sources for program presentations and following up with those organizations over time to identity new referrals.
  • • Expand partnerships through other service providers and volunteers to strengthen employment interventions and support.
  • • Attend supervision meetings

Job Summary


The Program Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, management, administration, and successful execution of all contract requirements in support of federal and Department of Defense (DoD) customers. This individual serves as the primary interface between the Government and contractor personnel, ensuring all Performance Work Statement (PWS) requirements are met while maintaining high standards of quality, compliance, and mission effectiveness. The Program Manager will oversee operational performance, contractual obligations, staffing, risk management, and customer engagement while providing strategic direction for program success.


Responsibilities

  • Provide overall program leadership, direction, and management for federal government contracts.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with Government stakeholders regarding contract performance, deliverables, and operational activities.
  • Manage and oversee execution of all Performance Work Statement (PWS) requirements.
  • Lead administrative and operational activities, ensuring contract objectives, milestones, and performance standards are met.
  • Develop and implement program management plans, processes, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Monitor contract performance, identify risks, develop mitigation strategies, and ensure timely resolution of issues.
  • Direct cross-functional teams and subcontractors to achieve program goals and maintain mission readiness.
  • Prepare and deliver written reports, executive briefings, and presentations to senior Government leadership.
  • Brief General Schedule (GS)-15 personnel, members of the Senior Executive Service (SES), and political appointees on program status, risks, accomplishments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal regulations, DoD policies, security requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Support business operations including staffing, budgeting, scheduling, quality assurance, and resource management.
  • Foster strong customer relationships and maintain effective communication with Government leadership and stakeholders.

Education and Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience managing federal government contracts.
  • Minimum of 5 years of Department of Defense (DoD) experience managing and overseeing the performance of all PWS tasks.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading administrative and operational functions for programs of similar size, scope, and complexity.
  • Bachelor's degree (Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science) in any discipline from an accredited institution

Required Skills

  • Experience with performance metrics, continuous process improvement, and risk management.
  • Strong knowledge of federal acquisition regulations, contract management, and DoD operating environments.
  • Proven ability to build relationships with senior Government leaders and stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Exceptional leadership and organizational skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication abilities.
  • Ability to manage complex programs and multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated strategic planning and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Experience developing executive-level reports, briefings, and recommendations.
  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced and highly regulated environments.
  • Strong understanding of federal and DoD contracting processes.

Security Clearance

Must possess a current, final, and fully adjudicated Top Secret security clearance.


More About B&A:

Notable Clients
B&A has grown to be a company that is trusted by our clients for exceptional service, innovative solutions, and inspired employees. Our service extends through federal, state, and local Government, the private sector, and higher education. Some of our notable clients include Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, U.S. Senate, U.S. Courts, U.S. Census Bureau, U.S. Navy, and more.

At B&A, we place significant importance on improving the communities and lives of citizens across the nation through our involvement, technology expertise, and employees. title: Electro-Mechanical Technician  (Hammond)
description:
The Electro-Mechanical Technician is primarily responsible for maintaining, repairing, testing, adjusting, and assisting in the installation and removal of all electrical, mechanical, communication, control, and measurement equipment at assigned locations; performing a variety of operations, maintenance, and construction tasks to maintain safe operations of the pipeline and its related facilities; and ensuring the facility is operated and maintained in compliance with all Company and applicable regulatory standards and practices.

Duties and Responsibilities:

The following represents the majority of the duties performed by the position, but is not meant to be all inclusive nor prevent other duties from being assigned when necessary.

1. Complies with DOT and OSHA health, safety and environmental requirements and follows safety philosophy and procedures developed by the Company including: applicable environmental, health and safety rules, procedures, and accepted safe work practices, the use of appropriate personal protective equipment and safety systems, and the reporting of workplace hazards and injury or illness arising from workplace activities; observes the workplace to identify conditions or behaviors that should be corrected and takes appropriate action.

2. Tests and inspects assigned equipment by monitoring performance and operating specialized mechanical and electronic testing equipment.

3. Maintains assigned mechanical, electrical, and electronic equipment by making adjustments and repairs as needed.

4. Compiles records and analyzes operating data on equipment.

5. Maintains equipment spare parts inventory and operates and maintains technicians’ tools equipment, and assigned vehicle.

6. Recommends equipment design changes, gives technical guidance, and suggests procedures for proper and efficient use of equipment.

7. Contacts and confers with factory technical representatives.

8. Installs non-contract equipment additions and modifications.

9. Works with third party contractor on R/W encroachments.

10. Acts as company inspector on construction and maintenance project performed by outside contractors.

11. Assists with on-the-job training of new technicians.

12. Performs all other duties and projects as assigned by supervisor.

13. Performs maintenance associated with upkeep, cleanliness, and appearance of pipeline right-of-way, terminal, and station facilities.

REQUIREMENTS

Education and Experience

· An Associate’s degree in electronics/electrical, instrumentation or a related technical field or its equivalent in experience is required. Experience as an operations/maintenance technician, or previous experience in electronics and mechanics is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

· Ability to actively engage in safe behavior and understand and follow the principles and methods related to pipeline and workplace safety as established by the Company.

· Knowledge of emergency and safety procedures, policies procedures, equipment operating parameters, and all applicable DOT, EPA, FERC, DHS and OSHA requirements.

· Knowledge of system operation, pipeline and facility layout, and equipment capability.

· Ability to work without direct supervision to accomplish goals and meet schedules.

· Knowledge of math, general science, hydraulics and strong mechanical and electrical aptitude.

· Ability to think logically and remain calm in stressful situations.

· Knowledge of equipment, processes, and physical ability to accomplish the task as assigned.

· Ability to safely drive and maneuver company vehicles.

· Ability to prepare and analyze data and figures.

· Ability to test, setup, troubleshoot, and maintain a variety of electronic/electrical and mechanical equipment to include but not limited to electrical motors (medium and low voltage), flow computers, programmable logic controllers (PLC), personal computers (PC), routers and switches, fluid level instruments such as radar gauges, AC and DC relay systems, switchgear, breakers, motor control centers, contactors, electrical and hydraulic, valve actuators, centrifugal and positive displacement pumps, pump seals, as well as various instrument and control equipment.

Ability to use various tools in the performance of of the above duties to include but not limited to digital and analog multimeters, dead weight tester, calibrated gauges, safety equipment, electrical power tools, electric shop crane and hoist, frequency counter, oscilloscope, line finder, probe bar, pipe threading equipment (electric and manual), ladders, and safety harness.

title: Certified Work Incentive Coordinator
description:
Under immediate to general supervision, the CWIC provides counseling and assistance to individuals in the Benefits, Employment, and Education program who are considering or anticipating changes in their benefits situation. This position is to provide information and guidance to Individual Placement and Support (IPS) employment specialists and provide participants assistance in obtaining comprehensive, individualized work incentives planning. Work in partnership with others as part of a structured inter-disciplinary team, within a Certified Community Behavioral Health Center (CCBHC) model. Services are predominantly delivered to an adult population who carry a serious mental illness, substance abuse, co-occurring and/or medically co-morbid diagnosis.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist clients with applying to various benefits
  • Provide guidance on benefits, work incentives, and employment services available to consumers.
  • Provide comprehensive, individualized work incentives planning for participants prior to job start
  • Provide information and assistance about reporting earnings to Social Security Administration (SSA), housing programs, etc., depending on the person’s benefits.
  • Facilitate access to work incentives planning when clients need to make decisions about changes in work hours and pay.
  • Work incentives planning includes SSA benefits, medical benefits, medication subsidies, housing subsidies, food stamps, spouse and dependent children benefits, past job retirement benefits and other source of income.
  • Provide information to beneficiaries on health benefits coverage options that may be available.
  • Show knowledge of SSA’s Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) disability programs and work incentives as well as other federal, state, and local work incentive programs and be able to communicate this knowledge in an effective and easy-to-understand manner.
  • Provide presentations and outreach to the community, in accordance with SSA guidelines.
  • Promote employment and self-sufficiency through the use of work incentives.
  • Maintain effective and ongoing communication with the IPS team(s).
  • Collect information about community resources, bringing new information back to staff and adding to resource database.
  • Complete training by an accredited institution, Cornell University or the University of Virginia Commonwealth.
  • Attend IPS 101 training
  • Complete continuing education and training necessary to maintain certifications.
  • Attend IPS supervision meetings and consultation calls to ensure the highest level of professional practice.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of current trends and developments in the mental health field by reading books, journals, and other relevant material.
  • Attend continuing education seminars and workshops to keep certifications current.
  • Develop and share recovery-oriented material with the assigned treatment team(s).
  • Actively seek new information to enhance the effectiveness of services.
  • Work with supervisor to establish contact with community partners and external referral sources for program presentations and following up with those organizations over time to identity new referrals.
  • Attend and participate in organizational meetings and treatment team meeting with multi-disciplinary team to utilize a team based care approach when working with clients.
  • Document client progress to maintain a permanent record of client activity according to established methods and procedures.
  • Demonstrates understanding of various best-practice treatment models to work with individuals with Serious Mental Illness, Co-occurring disorders, and trauma
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge on trauma informed evidenced based practices and co-occurring treatments

Bachelor’s Degree in social services or similar field required. CWIC certification from Cornell University or University of Virginia Commonwealth, or be willing to obtain within first 6 months of employment. Case Management Certification or obtain by taking the first available Case Management II Certification course provided by ODMHSAS after hire. Must have a strong commitment to the right and ability of each person served to live in normal community residences; and have access to helpful, adequate, competent, and continuous supports and services. Skills and competence to establish supportive trusting relationships with persons with mental illnesses and/or substance use issues and respect for client rights and personal preferences in treatment are essential. Knowledge of the service system, benefits, entitlements and supports utilized by people with disabilities. Must possess a valid Oklahoma Driver License and satisfactory driving record and use personal automobile to travel to locations other than primary office.

  • Preferred:
    • At least two years of documented experience working with persons with disabilities or personal experience with a disability preferred.
    • Minimum one-year experience in mental health care setting, preferably with Serious Mental Illness background

location: HM Primary Care Group - Spring Valley
description:
Full Time - Days - Spring Valley Location

At Houston Methodist, the Certified Hand Therapist (CHT) position is responsible for evaluating and developing the therapy plan of care for a broad range of hand and upper extremity diagnoses and acuities. As an experienced Therapist, this position provides education to hand and upper extremity patients, patient's family members, and/or caregivers and collaborates with other health care professionals as needed for problem resolution and/or achievement of identified patient specific goals. As a member of the direct patient care team, the CHT position provides patient care directly and through delegation to Occupational or Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) and Technicians and has responsibility for patient care delivered by assigned OTAs or PTAs and Technicians, delivering exceptional patient care with adherence to safety standards and guidelines to ensure optimal patient safety, customer service, and optimum patient outcomes. This position serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced hand and upper extremity staff to include other Occupational or Physical Therapists, assistants and technicians, and may act as a clinical instructor to OT or PT and OTA or PTA students, Residents, and Fellows.

FLSA STATUS
Non-exempt

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION
  • Graduate of education program approved by the credentialing body for the required credential(s) indicated below in the Certificates, Licenses and Registrations section

EXPERIENCE
  • Completion of HM or comparable Occupational or Physical Therapy Residency program, or three years of experience as a Physical or Occupational Therapist

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS
Required
  • Occupational Therapy or Physical Therapy state license and
  • BLS - Basic Life Support or Instructor (AHA) - American Heart Association and
  • CHT - Certified Hand Therapist (HTCC) - Healthcare Technology Certification Commission _PSV

SKILLS AND ABILITIES
  • Demonstrates the skills and competencies necessary to safely perform the assigned job, determined through on-going skills, competency assessments, and performance evaluations
  • Sufficient proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing the English language necessary to perform the essential functions of this job, especially with regard to activities impacting patient or employee safety or security
  • Ability to effectively communicate with patients, physicians, family members and co-workers in a manner consistent with a customer service focus and application of positive language principles
  • Demonstrates increasing expertise in treatments provided and/or for hand and upper extremity patient population
  • Ability to work independently, capable of handling challenging/difficult therapy procedures and patient care situations; demonstrates sound judgment and executes above average clinical skills
  • Exhibits strong interpersonal, teamwork and leadership skills with all levels of the healthcare team and assures delivery of excellent customer service to all patients, visitors, physicians and co-workers
  • Possesses proficient computer knowledge; operates multiple computer systems and standard Rehabilitation equipment
  • Demonstrates professional and technical competence in the selection, evaluation, utilization of treatment plans


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

PEOPLE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Promotes a positive work environment and contributes to a dynamic, team focused work unit that actively helps one another to achieve optimal department results. Collaborates with all members of the hand and upper extremity patient care team by actively communicating and reporting pertinent patient care information and data in a comprehensive manner.
  • Serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced hand therapists (occupational or physical therapists), helping to advance their professional practice at HM.
  • Teaches and provides guidance to Occupational or Physical Therapist Assistants, Technicians, and support staff. Assists with precepting students in clinical rotations and occupational or physical therapist residency or fellowship programs. May also serve as a clinical instructor.

SERVICE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Performs complete and comprehensive evaluation of patients across a broad range of hand and upper extremity diagnosis and acuities to identify patient’s level of function and to determine the treatment plan. Develops the plan of care based on evaluation findings, implementing the hand and upper extremity treatment plan.
  • Provides education to patients, patient’s family members, and/or caregivers. Serves as resource to colleagues in teaching best therapy practice in hand and upper extremity rehabilitation.
  • Collaborates and communicates with the healthcare team modifications to patient’s treatment plan, progress, and discharge planning for achievement of identified patient specific goals.

QUALITY/SAFETY ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Assesses hand and upper extremity patients regularly, monitoring progress towards treatment goals, modifying goals, plan or program as indicated. Recognizes complications/limitations associated with certain procedures and proactively addresses such for optimum outcomes. Collaborates and communicates with the healthcare team modifications to patient’s treatment plan, progress, and discharge planning.
  • Proactively identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement providing recommendations, and contributes to meeting departmental and hospital targets for quality and safety.
  • Provides oversight of patient care provided by OTAs or PTA’s and Technicians, ensuring quality outcomes and the safety of the patient, adjusting activities as applicable.

FINANCE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Uses resources efficiently to maximize utilization of time and equipment. Meets labor standards by effectively managing established patient load assignments.
  • Maintains accurate and complete documentation of patient education and procedures performed in a timely manner in the patient record. Enters charges for services provided as applicable.

GROWTH/INNOVATION ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Actively participates in departmental projects. Participates in HM related and approved hospital/community teaching opportunities, community services and/or functions.
  • Assists higher level OTs or PTs with program development and/or clinical competencies.
  • Seeks opportunities to advance and/or expand learning beyond basic competencies with a focus on continual development as a Certified Hand Therapist.

description:
Job Title: Data Migration & Conversion SpecialistJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a Principal Consultant specializing in Data Migration & Conversion to support a major federal HCM modernization initiative. In this role, you will lead the migration of HR data from legacy systems—including PeopleSoft HCM, Oracle EBS, and agency‑specific HRIS platforms—into Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM across multiple federal agencies.

You will architect and deliver high‑quality extraction, transformation, cleansing, and loading strategies using HDL and HSDL while ensuring data accuracy, federal compliance, and zero‑disruption cutovers. This role provides significant independence, the chance to solve complex data quality challenges at scale, and the opportunity to directly influence the modernization of federal HR systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead end‑to‑end data migration from legacy federal HR systems into Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM

  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines, data mapping, and transformation logic using HDL and HSDL

  • Conduct comprehensive data profiling, anomaly detection, and data quality analysis

  • Execute data cleansing routines to standardize values, remove duplicates, and align with EHRI and eOPF standards

  • Plan and perform iterative migration cycles (mock migrations, dress rehearsals, production cutover) across multiple agency complexity tiers

  • Perform parallel payroll validation testing to ensure zero‑dollar variance between legacy and Oracle Cloud payroll runs

  • Create/document migration runbooks, data dictionaries, conversion specifications, and reconciliation reports

  • Develop automated validation scripts to ensure record consistency, referential integrity, and compliance

  • Collaborate with federal HR policy experts to validate employee status, benefits eligibility, and personnel action accuracy

  • Partner with integration teams to ensure compatibility with EHRI, eOPF, payroll providers, and benefits carriers

  • Support data governance, issue triage, and data quality metric reporting

  • Serve as a technical expert and mentor; lead small workstreams and review technical deliverables

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Ability to obtain/maintain a Public Trust clearance (U.S. Citizenship required)

  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of relevant experience (or equivalent experience)

  • 7+ years of experience in data migration, data conversion, or ETL development

  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM, Oracle ERP Cloud, or similar platforms using HDL, HSDL, or FBDI

  • Strong SQL skills for data analysis, validation, and reconciliation

  • Experience with large‑scale data profiling and cleansing (100K+ records)

  • Familiarity with ETL tools such as ODI, Informatica, Talend, or Python‑based pipelines

  • Understanding of key HR data domains (employee master data, jobs, positions, compensation, benefits, personnel action history)

  • Experience working in Agile or SAFe environments

Desired:

  • 8+ years of data migration experience, including one large Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementation (5,000+ employees)

  • Direct experience with HDL templates, HSDL spreadsheets, and BI Publisher validation reporting

  • Experience migrating federal HR data from PeopleSoft, Oracle EBS, or custom HRIS platforms

  • Knowledge of federal HR data standards (EHRI elements, eOPF document types, SF‑50 fields, federal reporting requirements)

  • Experience with parallel payroll validation and automated variance analysis

  • Proficiency with Python or R for scripting and data quality reporting

  • OCI Data Integration or Oracle Data Integrator certification

  • Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$90,300-$189,600

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

description:
Ready to make an impact? Join a stable and growing organization where your career can flourish! If you're excited about new opportunities, keep reading!


At Trace-A-Matic, our people are our greatest assets! We offer a friendly, clean, and safe work environment where everyone can thrive. Our mission is to achieve excellence in complex precision machined components and ensure customer satisfaction. Plus, we have a fantastic Gainsharing program: when the company profits, we share 50% with our employees, paid out quarterly!


Trace-A-Matic offers:

  • 10 Paid Holidays
  • Service-Based PTO
  • Gainsharing

  • 401k with company contribution
  • Exciting, fast-paced environment with cutting edge equipment/manufacturing processes

  • Weekly Pay
  • Performance Merit Raises

Trace-A-Matic is hiring Assembler/Operators for 2nd, or split shift, see below:


Position Overview:

Perform mechanical assembly in a cleanroom using hand tools and established procedures. Operate CNC cells, inspect parts, process through cleaning systems, and maintain accurate records while supporting a safe and efficient work environment.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Tend automated CNC machine production cell
  • Load and unload parts using predetermined procedures using torque tools
  • Interact with robotic cell software to assure maximum uptime
  • Complete required dimensional inspections using hand tools (micrometer, caliper bore gage) and automated CMM
  • Perform visual inspection of components after machining
  • Process parts though semi-automated ultrasonic cleaning system prior to assembly
  • Perform mechanical assembly in accordance with specified procedures in a cleanroom workspace
  • Read and comprehend instructions and follow established procedures
  • Use basic hand and power tools, i.e. sockets, screwdriver, torque tools, wrenches etc.
  • Keep records of production quantities and time
  • Report on issues, malfunction or defective parts
  • Prepare for work to be accomplished by studying assembly instructions, blueprint specifications, and parts lists; gather parts, tools, and materials
  • Assemble components by examining connections for correct fit; fastening parts and subassemblies
  • Maintain safe and clean working environment by complying with procedures, rules, and regulations
  • Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed

title: Manager, Security
description:
The Manager of Security Operations provides strategic leadership, operational oversight, and administrative management of Family & Children's Services' security program across multiple facilities, including Tulsa, Oklahoma City, Norman, and surrounding counties/service areas. This position provides regional security leadership, directly supervises assigned security personnel and security leaders, and provides indirect oversight and operational support to site-based security teams in other counties.

The Manager of Security Operations leads all aspects of security operations, including staffing, training, performance management, security technology, incident response, investigations, and regulatory compliance. As a member of the FCS Safety Team and Incident Response Team, this position plays a key role in organizational preparedness, crisis management, business continuity, workplace violence prevention, and regional safety initiatives.

Security personnel at FCS are viewed as an extension of client care teams. The Manager of Security Operations fosters a culture that balances hospitality, customer service, and therapeutic engagement with effective security practices, utilizing traditional security skills and interventions only when necessary. The successful candidate will possess exceptional leadership skills, executive presence, high emotional intelligence, resilience, and the ability to lead effectively through continual organizational change.

POSITION SPECIFIC DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Leadership & Program Management

  • Provide strategic direction and long-term planning for the FCS Security Program across all assigned locations.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain standardized security policies, procedures, service standards, and training programs to ensure consistency across all FCS facilities.
  • Serve as the organization's senior operational leader and subject matter expert for physical security, workplace violence prevention, emergency preparedness, and security operations.
  • Provide leadership, direction, and operational support to security supervisors and security teams across multiple facilities in Tulsa, Oklahoma City, Norman, and surrounding service areas.
  • Conduct regular site visits, security assessments, operational reviews, and vulnerability analyses to evaluate effectiveness, identify risks, and implement corrective actions.
  • Develop and monitor security-related key performance indicators (KPIs), incident trends, compliance indicators, staffing effectiveness, and vulnerability assessments to support continuous improvement and risk reduction.
  • Identify opportunities to improve security operations through innovation, technology enhancements, process improvement, and standardized security practices.

Staffing, Supervision & Contract Management

  • Direct the recruitment, selection, onboarding, scheduling, supervision, coaching, and performance management of internal security personnel and contracted security officers.
  • Mentor, coach, and develop security supervisors and emerging leaders to support performance management, succession planning, employee retention, and professional development.
  • Conduct regular staffing analyses and develop staffing plans that align security resources with organizational needs.
  • Review staffing models, scheduling practices, and deployment strategies to ensure adequate coverage and efficient utilization of security resources across all locations.

title: ITSM  Architecture and Design
description:
The MOVEit Transfer & Automation Support Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day support, administration, and continuous improvement of the organization's Managed File Transfer (MFT) platform built on Progress MOVEit Transfer and MOVEit Automation. This role spans three layers of support: resolving end-user issues related to file transfers and access, maintaining and configuring the MOVEit application stack, and supporting infrastructure-level architecture changes and migration activities (including version upgrades, server/OS migrations, and on-prem-to-cloud transitions). The ideal candidate combines strong troubleshooting skills with hands-on MFT administration experience and the ability to collaborate across infrastructure, security, and application teams during migration and upgrade initiatives.

1. End-User Support

  • Act as first and second-level point of contact for business users experiencing issues with MOVEit Transfer web interface, desktop/SFTP clients, or automated file exchange workflows.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve failed or delayed file transfers, login and authentication failures, and folder/permission access errors.

  • Manage end-user account lifecycle: provisioning, de-provisioning, password resets, and multi-factor authentication (MFA) setup.

  • Own and work assigned tickets in the ITSM queue (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy) within defined SLAs, ensuring timely communication and resolution.

  • Liaise with business stakeholders and external trading partners to clarify transfer requirements, provide status updates, and explain root cause of incidents.

  • Create and maintain end-user documentation, FAQs, and knowledge base articles to reduce recurring support requests.

  • Conduct basic training/onboarding sessions for new users and departments adopting the MFT platform.

2. Application-Level Support

  • Monitor health, availability, and performance of MOVEit Transfer and MOVEit Automation servers, including job/task queues and failed transfer alerts.

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot MOVEit Automation workflows/tasks, including PGP encryption/decryption steps, file processing scripts, and conditional logic.

  • Manage SSL/TLS and PGP certificates used for secure transfers, including tracking expirations, renewals, and rotation.

  • Apply patches, hotfixes, and version upgrades to MOVEit Transfer and MOVEit Automation in line with vendor (Progress Software) release cycles and internal change control.

  • Configure and support integrations with internal and external systems over SFTP, FTPS, AS2, and REST/SOAP APIs.

  • Administer user roles, groups, organizational policies, and folder-level permissions within MOVEit in accordance with least-privilege and compliance requirements.

  • Analyze application and transfer logs to identify root cause of task failures, performance degradation, or security anomalies.

  • Perform configuration backups, restores, and validate application-level disaster recovery / high-availability failover between primary and DR MOVEit instances.

  • Participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) reviews for all application-level changes, ensuring proper documentation, testing, and rollback plans.

  • Support internal and external audits by providing evidence of access controls, encryption standards, and transfer logs.

3. Infrastructure-Level Architecture & Migration Support

  • Support infrastructure architecture reviews, capacity planning, and environment sizing for MOVEit deployments across on-premises and cloud (Azure/AWS) environments.

  • Participate as a technical contributor in migration projects such as MOVEit version upgrades, Windows Server/OS upgrades, SQL Server database migrations, and on-prem-to-cloud (or MOVEit Cloud) transitions.

  • Coordinate with infrastructure, network, security, and database administration teams on server provisioning, load balancer and firewall configuration, and DNS changes required for migrations.

  • Contribute to and maintain architecture documentation, including High-Level Design (HLD) / Low-Level Design (LLD) documents, network diagrams, and disaster recovery / business continuity plans.

  • Develop and execute migration runbooks and cutover plans, including pre-migration readiness checks and post-migration validation/smoke testing.

  • Support decommissioning of legacy MOVEit servers and environments following successful migration and validation.

  • Ensure migration and architecture activities comply with organizational security standards, including encryption at rest and in transit, network segmentation, and access control policies.

  • Support periodic disaster recovery (DR) testing and business continuity exercises for the MOVEit infrastructure footprint.

  • Support High Availability (HA) migration activities, including HA cluster setup/reconfiguration, node failover testing, and validation of load-balanced MOVEit environments during upgrades or infrastructure moves.

Required Technical Skills

  • Hands-on administration experience with MOVEit Transfer and MOVEit Automation (or comparable MFT platforms such as GoAnywhere, IBM Sterling, Axway).

  • Strong working knowledge of file transfer protocols: SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS, and AS2.

  • Windows Server administration and IIS configuration/troubleshooting.

  • SQL Server database administration fundamentals (MOVEit's backend database).

  • Scripting experience with PowerShell (or similar) for automation and task remediation.

  • PGP encryption and SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle management.

  • Foundational networking knowledge: firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and network segmentation.

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure and/or AWS) relevant to infrastructure migration projects.

  • Familiarity with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Remedy) and ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management processes.

title: Safeguarding Officer
description:
Job Title: Safeguarding Officer

Location: UK, Remote

Salary: £45k - £50k per annum, dependent on experience

Hours: Full Time

Contract Type: Permanent

Reports To: Global Safeguarding Lead

Direct Reports: N/A

Key Internal Contacts/Relationships: Programme teams(national and international staff), regional team, HQ teams (including UK, Europe, and US), HR, EXCO,

Key External Contacts/Relationships: Including but not limited to: donors, survivor support services in country, third parties, including community members, beneficiaries.

Job Purpose: To support the Global Safeguarding Lead (GSGL) to strengthen and embed safeguarding across all programmes and headquarters functions

About HALO:

HALO is the leading global NGO addressing the impact and drivers of conflict in 30 countries and territories, with over 8,000 staff. Most of our staff are local employees and include a growing number of women.

Our primary duty is to serve people affected by conflict, clearing landmines and the explosive remnants of war that threaten lives and livelihoods long after fighting has finished. We make land safe where war has ended, while also assisting those affected by active conflict and endemic violence.

HALO addresses human suffering caused by armed violence in some of the world’s most fragile places, securing weapons and ammunition and working with both state and community actors to reduce the prevalence of armed violence.

About the role:

The Safeguarding Officer plays a key role in supporting the Global Safeguarding Lead (GSGL) to strengthen and embed safeguarding across all programmes and headquarters functions. The postholder will provide expert guidance and support to programme teams, help drive continuous improvement through safeguarding self-reviews and action plans, contribute to safeguarding case management and investigations, and support the design and delivery of safeguarding training and awareness initiatives across the organisation.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the monitoring and review of safeguarding self-reviews and action plans across programmes, providing practical support and guidance to ensure progress against agreed objectives. This may involve occasional international travel.
  • Lead or support safeguarding risk assessments across programmes and functions, ensuring mitigation measures are identified, implemented and reviewed to reduce the risk of harm.
  • Support programme teams to assess, strengthen and monitor safeguarding capacity within implementing partners, contractors and external stakeholders.
  • Support the GSGL in the design, development, and delivery of safeguarding training programmes, ensuring staff at all levels understand their safeguarding responsibilities and are equipped to apply them effectively.
  • Develop engaging safeguarding communications, awareness-raising resources, and training materials that are accessible, inclusive, and appropriate for diverse audiences and reinforce a speak up culture.
  • Support the development, implementation and monitoring of community-based safeguarding reporting and complaints mechanisms to ensure they are accessible, trusted and survivor-centred.
  • Support safeguarding case management processes, ensuring responses are survivor-centred, confidential, timely and aligned with organisational policies and international best practice.
  • Coordinate with HR, legal, security and programme teams on cases that involve employees, partners or contractors.
  • Work collaboratively with recruitment teams across regions and programmes to promote and strengthen safeguarding practices throughout the recruitment and onboarding process.
  • Coordinate and facilitate the safeguarding Community of Practice, bringing together safeguarding leads and focal points across the organisation to share learning, strengthen collaboration, and promote best practice.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of safeguarding systems, processes, and initiatives in response to organisational priorities and emerging needs.
  • Support statutory and donor reporting obligations, including serious incident reports to the Charity Commission and notifications to institutional donors.
  • Support Managers and safeguarding focal points in the field/country offices to apply policy consistently.
  • Monitor developments in sector standards and regulatory requirements and flag implications for policy or practice.

General:

  • Uphold HALO’s core values and standards, promoting its ethos and mission statement.
  • Ensure familiarity with and adherence to all HALO policies and procedures.
  • Carry out all duties in a manner that is sensitive to cultural contexts and compliant with local legal frameworks.
  • Champion and uphold safeguarding standards, acting with due care to protect anyone who comes into contact with HALO's work and reporting any concerns promptly and appropriately.
  • Fulfil responsibilities in line with HALO's health and safety policies and procedures.
  • Undertake any other duties reasonably required to support departmental objectives and operational requirements.

Travel Requirements:

  • Occasional international travel required

Requirements

  • Demonstrable international experience, or strong awareness of cultural differences across diverse programme settings, with up to date knowledge of international safeguarding standards.
  • Demonstrable experience in safeguarding within an INGO.
  • Experience of supporting or leading safeguarding investigations.
  • Experience designing and/or delivering training and capacity-building activities.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in complex, fast paced, and evolving environments, demonstrating resilience and adaptability.
  • Level 2 of the Investigator Qualification Training Scheme (CHS Alliance), or equivalent
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and develop effective working relationships across programmes and functions.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and committed to promoting and strengthening safeguarding practice.
  • Ability to think analytically, draw conclusions and evidence analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive information with a high degree of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience supporting the implementation of safeguarding systems, frameworks, or programmes.
  • Level 3 of the Investigator Qualification Training Scheme (CHS Alliance), or equivalent.
  • Experience working in the prevention of gender-based violence (GBV) or related protection programming.
  • Experience working in international development, humanitarian, or international operational settings.
  • Willingness and ability to undertake international travel when required.
  • Proficiency in another language.

Benefits

  • 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 statutory holidays
  • Non-contributory life assurance
  • Private medical insurance
  • Pension contributions matched by HALO up to 5%
  • Emergency medical insurance while travelling overseas
  • Flexible working policy

Please submit a CV (no more than 2 pages) and a cover letter (no more than 1 page) outlining how your experience matches the key skills and competencies required by 24th September 2026. Applications without a cover letter tailored to this position will not be considered.

We reserve the right to amend the closing date depending on the number of applications received.

The HALO Trust is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment because of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

The HALO Trust is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented individuals from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

The HALO Trust is committed to ensuring that it provides a safe and trusted environment which safeguards and promotes the welfare and wellbeing of anyone who comes into contact with, or is part of, the Charity, with a zero-tolerance approach to behaviours which challenge this.

title: Risk & Resilience Associate
description:
ASMO is a groundbreaking joint venture between DHL and Aramco. Inheriting DHL’s logistics excellence and Aramco’s extensive supply chain ecosystem, we are here to set a new benchmark and redefine the procurement and supply chain landscape, enabling growth.

ASMO aims to provide reliable end-to-end integrated procurement and supply chain services for companies across the industrial, energy, chemical, and petrochemical sectors. Our focus customers in the short term will be Saudi Aramco and its Affiliates. In the long term, all the industrial sectors within Saudi Arabia aim to reach the MENA region.

Objective:

The role holder is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing efficient procurement risk management tools, processes, and procedures. The Procurement Risk & Resilience focuses on identifying potential risks, creating corrective plans, and ensuring that vendor partnerships align with ASMO’s policies & procedures.

General Responsibilities:

  • Develop and integrate procurement risk management tools, templates, methods, and processes to minimize risks associated with purchasing and ensure compliance with ASMO’s policies and procedures
  • Ensure that risk management policies and procedures related to purchasing are regularly reviewed and updated to align with best practices.

  • Lead assessments of vendor risk, identifying potential risks, and developing mitigation plans.

title: Project Coordinator, Manager
description:
Remote Bilingual Construction Project & Service Operations Coordinator

Sellax Roofing | Commercial Roofing — Ontario, Canada

Location: Remote, Latin America
Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, Ontario/Eastern Time
Languages: Professional English and Spanish
Commitment: Dedicated, long-term position

About the Role

Sellax Roofing is looking for a self-directed Construction Project & Service Operations Coordinator to manage the daily coordination of our commercial roofing projects, emergency service calls, repairs, maintenance and warranty work.

This is not a basic administrative or data-entry position. You will be trusted to organize people, investigate problems, find answers and keep work moving without constant supervision.

You will coordinate customers, field employees, subcontractors, suppliers and management while protecting schedules, budgets and customer commitments.

What You Will Own

  • Maintain the production and service schedule.

  • Coordinate crews, technicians, subcontractors and suppliers.

  • Confirm that access, materials, equipment, labour and approvals are ready before work begins.

  • Manage emergency leak calls, repairs, maintenance visits and warranty callbacks.

  • Communicate appointments, progress, delays and next steps to customers.

  • Track daily production and organize recovery plans when work falls behind.

  • Investigate operational problems and implement practical solutions within your authority.

  • Bring management recommendations—not only problems—when approval is required.

  • Maintain accurate tasks, notes, labour hours, photographs, documents and communications in JobTread.

  • Track additional work, change requests and supporting documentation.

  • Review project budgets and compare estimated costs against actual labour, materials, equipment and subcontractor costs.

  • Identify cost overruns, idle labour, wasted trips, missing costs and unbilled work.

  • Prepare complete project and service records for operational review and billing.

  • Turn recurring problems into better procedures, checklists and systems.

What We Are Looking For

  • Professional spoken and written English and Spanish.

  • Experience in construction coordination, field-service operations, property maintenance or a similar environment.

  • Strong leadership and the confidence to hold employees, subcontractors and suppliers accountable.

  • Ability to coordinate multiple projects and urgent service requests under pressure.

  • Strong independent problem-solving and research skills.

  • A proactive approach: identify risks and communicate before they become emergencies.

  • Knowledge of construction budgeting, job costing and basic financial analysis.

  • Ability to review budget-versus-actual costs, labour productivity and projected cost to complete.

  • Strong Excel, organizational and digital-system skills.

  • Professional customer communication and complaint-management skills.

  • Good judgment about when to act independently and when approval is required.

  • Persistence when the first solution does not work.

  • Reliable internet, computer and professional remote workspace.

  • A genuine desire to build a stable, long-term career with Sellax Roofing.

Commercial roofing and JobTread experience are preferred but are not mandatory for someone with strong construction or field-service experience who can learn quickly.

The Right Person for This Position

You will succeed in this role if you naturally take ownership, follow through without reminders and continue working until an issue is resolved.

You are comfortable finding missing information, making decisions, having difficult conversations and coordinating people remotely. You do not simply report problems—you investigate them, develop options and recommend the best next action.

We value honesty, reliability, long-term commitment and people who want to help build better systems as the company grows.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Projects and service calls remain organized and moving.

  • Crews arrive prepared with the required access, materials and equipment.

  • Customers receive timely and professional communication.

  • Commitments are completed without repeated management follow-up.

  • Preventable delays, wasted trips and idle labour are reduced.

  • JobTread information remains accurate and current.

  • Budget and profitability risks are identified early.

  • Change-order and billing documentation is complete.

  • Recurring operational problems are converted into lasting improvements.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a live interview in both English and Spanish and work through practical construction, customer-service and problem-solving scenarios.

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
About Us

Si desea saber un poco más sobre esta oportunidad, o está considerando presentar su candidatura, por favor, lea la siguiente información del puesto.

We are Emineo, experts in software engineering with a passion for innovative and successful projects, we offer exciting challenges in an international environment. Emineo is synonymous with an extraordinary team spirit and independent work, all in an attractive location in the center of the city of Valencia. We ensure adequate knowledge and provide all the necessary tools to develop convincing solutions through continuous training of our employees.

Your job

As a Lead DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for our container and cloud infrastructures and shape our CI/CD standards. You will support projects throughout their entire lifecycle – from design and engineering to continuous optimization and stable operations – ensuring that customer solutions run securely, reliably, and at scale.

Key Responsibilities

1. Own the Platform. You design, build, and operate container and cloud infrastructures based on Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure – secure, scalable, and tailored to our customers’ needs.

2. Build & Run End-to-End. You support projects from initial setup through productive operations. Stability, performance, and continuous improvement are your responsibility.

3. Set Standards. You influence architectural decisions, define standards for security, monitoring, and deployment, and actively drive the evolution of our platforms.

4. CI/CD as the Backbone. You are responsible for our central GitLab CI/CD infrastructure – from pipeline blueprints and upgrades to onboarding new projects.

5. Automation First. You establish and improve Infrastructure-as-Code practices, deployment processes, and monitoring setups. Repeatability and traceability are core principles for you.

6. Work Closely with Customers. You analyze requirements, challenge assumptions constructively, and work with customers to find pragmatic solutions – collaboratively and efficiently.

7. Multiply Knowledge. You help development teams grow through code reviews, training sessions, and direct collaboration, raising technical quality across projects.

8. AI in Everyday Engineering. You use AI tools effectively and actively help shape how they are integrated into our engineering practices.

What makes you the perfect candidate

1. Drive Instead of Routine. You are not looking for a comfortable routine. Complex system landscapes, demanding stakeholders, and high availability requirements motivate you.

2. Container & Cloud Expertise. You have solid experience with Docker and Kubernetes and are familiar with Azure – or highly motivated to deepen your expertise quickly.

3. CI/CD Experience. You know GitLab CI/CD (or comparable platforms) and understand what makes a production-ready pipeline. Pipeline design, runner management, and upgrades are familiar territory for you – or areas you are eager to master.

4. Operations & Monitoring. You understand what matters in production environments. Monitoring, logging, alerting, certificate management, and incident management are either already part of your skill set or challenges you actively embrace.

5. Security by Design. Compliance, IAM, Zero Trust, and micro-segmentation are not just buzzwords to you – you strive to make them standard practice.

6. Technical Communication. You can communicate complex technical concepts clearly to development teams, customers, and stakeholders in both German and English.

7. Agile Mindset. You are comfortable working in Scrum or Kanban environments and actively contribute to improving processes.

8. Education. A degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience that speaks for itself.

Your benefits

1. International environment. We have exchange programs with our offices in Switzerland and Germany.

2. Amazing work environment in our office in Valencia City center. Our office is well connected with public transportations, it is close to shops, restaurants and many other interesting places.

3. Flexible hours.

4. Total flexibility of homeoffice.

5. In addition to many events, we often organize after-work and team building events to promote a good relationship and a fun atmosphere within the team.

6. Competitive salary + bonus.

7. Possibility of health insurance and life insurance.

8. Continuous training: English and German classes, unlimited access to Udemy and additional technical training.

9. You will have a coach at your disposal to help you with everything you need, especially during your first stage with us.

10. Referral friend Program. If you bring a referenced person you receive a bonus when joining and another one after 3 months.

11. Intensive schedule on Fridays and in July and August.

12. 25 days of holidays.

13. For us it is important that you feel comfortable, so when you come to the office you will find fresh fruit, coffee, panoramic screens, adjustable tables and of course a cozy atmosphere that will make you feel at home.

We are looking forward to your application

Your contact person

Cristina Lobo Muñoz

HR Manager/Talent Acquisition

emineo Spain S.A.U.

Baar – Lausanne – Valencia – Zürich

T



Über uns

Wir sind Emineo, Experten für Software-Engineering mit einer Leidenschaft für innovative und erfolgreiche Projekte. Wir bieten spannende Herausforderungen in einem internationalen Umfeld. Emineo steht für einen außergewöhnlichen Teamgeist und selbständiges Arbeiten an einem attraktiven Standort im Zentrum der Stadt Valencia. Durch kontinuierliche Weiterbildung unserer Mitarbeiter sorgen wir für ausreichendes Wissen und bieten alle notwendigen Werkzeuge, um überzeugende Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Das ist deine Aufgabe

Als Lead DevOps Engineer verantwortest du unsere Container- und Cloud-Infrastrukturen und prägst CI/CD-Standards. Du begleitest Projekte durch den gesamten Zyklus – von der Konzeption über das Engineering und die kontinuierliche Optimierung bis zum stabilen Betrieb – und sorgst dafür, dass Kundenlösungen sicher, skalierbar und zuverlässig laufen.

Hauptaufgaben

1. Plattformen verantworten: Du konzipierst, baust und betreibst Container- und Cloud-Infrastrukturen auf Basis von Docker, Kubernetes und Azure – sicher, skalierbar und auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden zugeschnitten.

2. Build & Run aus einer Hand: Du begleitest Projekte vom Aufbau bis in den Betrieb – Stabilität, Performance und kontinuierliche Verbesserung liegen in deiner Hand.

3. Standards setzen: Du prägst Architekturentscheide, definierst Standards für Sicherheit, Monitoring und Deployment und treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattformen aktiv voran.

4. CI/CD als Rückgrat: Du verantwortest unsere zentrale CI/CD-Infrastruktur auf GitLab – von Pipeline-Blueprints über Upgrades bis zum Onboarding neuer Projekte.

5. Automatisierung als Prinzip: Du etablierst und verbesserst Infrastructure-as-Code, Deployment-Prozesse und Monitoring-Setups – Wiederholbarkeit und Nachvollziehbarkeit sind dein Anspruch.

6. Kundennah arbeiten: Du analysierst Anforderungen, hinterfragst konstruktiv und findest gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden pragmatische Lösungen – auf Augenhöhe, ohne Umwege.

7. Know-how multiplizieren: Du bringst Entwicklungsteams in Code Reviews, Trainings und direktem Austausch voran – und hebst damit die technische Qualität im gesamten Projekt.

8. AI im Engineering-Alltag: Du setzt AI-Tools gezielt ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir sie in unsere Engineering-Praxis integrieren.

Das bringst du mit

1. Drive statt Routine: Du suchst nicht die komfortable Routine – komplexe Systemlandschaften, anspruchsvolle Stakeholder und hohe Verfügbarkeitsanforderungen motivieren dich.

2. Container- und Cloud: Du hast solide Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes und kennst dich in Azure aus – oder bist entschlossen, dich dort schnell zu vertiefen.

3. CI/CD: Du kennst GitLab CI/CD (oder vergleichbare Plattformen) und weisst, was eine produktionsreife Pipeline ausmacht – Pipeline-Design, Runner-Management und Upgrades sind dir vertraut oder du willst es werden.
