  • Translate case objectives into appropriate database designs, data-processing workflows, review approaches, analyses, and production strategies.
  • Assist litigation teams with the strategic and legal aspects of electronic discovery.
  • Coordinate eDiscovery activities across data processing, database loading, document review, analysis, quality control, and production.
  • Participate in legal proceedings and discovery-planning activities, including Rule 26(f) conferences.
  • Prepare technical affidavits and other supporting documentation, as required.
  • Oversee the creation, validation, and delivery of statistical and case-related reports.
  • Coordinate project priorities, schedules, dependencies, client expectations, and technical risks.
  • Apply eDiscovery technologies, processes, and industry best practices to large-scale matters involving complex discovery challenges.
  • Coordinate with technical personnel to resolve database, processing, review, and production issues.
  • Assist remote users with accessing, navigating, and working within Relativity workspaces.
  • Communicate project status, emerging concerns, and recommended solutions to litigation teams and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain organized documentation supporting technical decisions, project activities, workflows, and deliverables.
  • Provide technical direction and guidance to eDiscovery personnel supporting assigned matters.

title: Senior Right of Way Agent
description:
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The following represents the majority of the duties performed by the position but is not meant to be all inclusive nor prevent other duties from being assigned when necessary.

3. Estimates right of way costs and establishes acquisition timelines.

4. Develops a landowner line list from tax roll information and internal mapping system and prepares limited title certificates from research data obtained from public land records.

5. Obtains permission to survey from landowners and tenants; identifies issues for proposed routes; identifies necessary agency/entity permits and generation of plats, maps, and data required to acquire right of way.

6. Prepares and files permit applications required by affected agencies/entities.

representing the Company's position; resolves other aspects of right of way encroachment.

8. Assists in the preparation of condemnation files and supports real property related litigation.

9. Negotiates the sale of company property and prepares documents to support the sale; negotiates and administers right of way and related rental payments.

10. Reviews and approves right of way, leases, licenses, and other real property contracts and maintains right of way files and records.

11. Documents right of way damages incurred during construction and recommends resolution of all right of way damages with contractor(s) and owners/tenants.

12. Assists with determining the appraised value of rights of way and engages in acquisition negotiations and coordinates the amount and method of payment for rights of way and other landowner related payments within Company policy guidelines.

13. Supports Engineering and Operations regarding new projects, relocations, right of way, and landowner matters.

14. Supports contractor right of way agents.

15. Assists with representing the Company before governmental agencies and at industry meetings, regarding real property, and right of way matters.

16. Provides guidance and training to other personnel on right of way, landowner, and related matters.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

· Ability to actively engage in safe behavior and understand and follow the principles and methods related to pipeline and workplace safety as established by the Company.

· Knowledge of emergency and safety procedures, policies, procedures, equipment operating parameters, and all applicable DOT, EPA, FERC, DHS, and OSHA requirements.

· Ability to utilize computer hardware and word processing and GIS software to research, manage, record, and evaluate company information.

· Well-developed verbal communication skills are needed to represent the company before government agencies, industry groups, and landowners. Also required during negotiations with landowners, claimants, and other external parties.

· Well-developed written communication skills are required to draft contracts, agreements, leases, licenses, and other right of way documents to accurately represent the Company’s position.

· Strong knowledge of right of way agreements, leases, licenses, and other legal contracts.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills for highly complex issues.

Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it. This exceptional content, reach and scope offers advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:

Working remotely in London with others in The London Free Press newsroom, you meet the twin demands of speed and quality as a multimedia journalist able to move up a fast learning curve. An enterprising self-starter and team player, you have a sense for stories that resonate with London’s diverse readership. The position requires working to tight deadlines, in clear, concise writing that engages readers, covering a wide range of news, entertainment and other subjects. Critical is the ability to use digital tools to break and develop stories, reflecting readers' real-time interests.

The position begins in September 2026.

What you’ll do:

  • Report and write stories – and be able to shoot photos for them – for digital and print audiences, and tailor content to meet those platforms’ varying needs.
  • Have and develop local story ideas daily, a job essential along with the flexibility to quickly pivot to other newsroom priorities to meet changing needs.
  • Use social media and other digital tools to find out what’s breaking and what Londoners in real time are talking about and which quickly needs our attention.
  • Cultivate sources to break stories and help set the news agenda.
  • File video clips for digital platforms; work with digital teams to create interactive content and other multimedia elements that both engage and enrich readers.

Who you are:

  • A journalism school graduate or candidate from a related field. Newsroom experience is an asset. You must be able to quickly layer and prioritize needs to move up a learning curve.
  • Flexible to write effectively in breaking news, features and short form, a job essential, along with non-traditional story formats such as explainers and Q/As.
  • Hungry to make the most of a chance to work in a daily newsroom with top-notch journalists and eager to show what you can do to help the room.
  • A digger, not satisfied with pat answers; always looking for hidden story angles and with a talent, or developing one, for explanatory journalism.
  • A reporter interested not just in what happened or is happening, but also why and how, with the ability to concisely convey that added meaning to readers.
  • Experience and strength in video or podcast presentation is an asset.
  • A valid driver’s licence and access to a personal vehicle are also assets.

title: Director of Integration
description:
Role Overview
The Director, Integration supports the operating program management of the Integration Management Office (IMO), with responsibility for coordinating, tracking, and driving execution of post-merger integration workstreams across the combined Pond & ENERCON platform. This role helps translate the executives’ strategic integration priorities into organized, actionable work across business units, functional leaders, and shared services.
This is a high-visibility role in a PE-backed environment where speed, structure, and follow-through matter. The Director, Integration must be comfortable managing detailed workplans, facilitating cross-functional meetings, identifying risks, and ensuring that workstream owners remain aligned and accountable.
Key Responsibilities
IMO Program Management

Support the development and maintenance of the master integration plan, including workstream coordination, dependency mapping, milestone tracking, and escalation protocols.

Help establish and maintain the IMO operating rhythm, including weekly status reviews, executive updates, and cross-workstream coordination meetings.

Maintain accurate integration trackers and scorecards, ensuring workstream status, risks, decisions, and upcoming milestones are clearly documented.

Identify integration blockers and risks proactively, coordinate resolution with workstream leaders, and escalate issues requiring executive attention.

Workstream Coordination (Examples, not limited to)

Coordinate integration activities across major functional areas, including IT systems consolidation, HR and total rewards harmonization, finance and reporting alignment, branding and go-to-market, and client and contract continuity.

Support the CTO’s AI adoption rollout and the extension of technology programs from Pond to the full combined platform.

Work with PDG leadership to support resource model alignment between legacy Pond and ENERCON shared-service structures.

Coordinate with BU EVPs, Presidents, and functional leaders to understand business-unit integration needs, track action items, and surface risks.

Stakeholder Management & Communications

Prepare integration status updates, meeting materials, action logs, and decision documents for the CTO, IMO leadership, executive steering groups, and other senior stakeholders.

Support the development and execution of the integration communications cadence for internal stakeholders, from frontline managers to the senior leadership team.

Build productive working relationships across Pond-heritage and ENERCON-heritage teams and help navigate cultural and organizational differences.

Serve as a reliable point of contact for workstream leaders and internal stakeholders regarding integration timelines, deliverables, and next steps.

Value Capture & Synergy Tracking

Support the CFO, CTO, and integration leadership in tracking integration-related cost and revenue synergies against established objectives.

Maintain documentation and reporting materials needed for sponsor, executive, and board updates.

Monitor progress against synergy milestones, flag potential delays, and coordinate corrective actions with the appropriate workstream owners.

Ideal Candidate Profile
Experience

5–12 years of experience, including meaningful involvement in post-merger integration, transformation, program management, or similarly complex cross-functional initiatives.

Experience in a PE-backed environment is preferred; familiarity with integration governance, sponsor reporting, and value-capture activities is a plus.

Experience in engineering, AEC, environmental, technical services, or another project-based professional services environment is a meaningful differentiator.

Big Four or boutique advisory experience in PMI, strategy, or transformation is welcome, particularly for candidates seeking to move into an operating role.

Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex, multi-workstream programs with cross-functional dependencies and senior stakeholder visibility.

Skills & Competencies

Strong program management discipline, including experience with workplans, status reporting, governance processes, action tracking, and risk management.

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize information into clear updates, risks, and decision requests for senior leaders.

High EQ and cultural fluency, with the ability to build trust across two distinct firm identities and work effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

Analytical orientation and comfort working with financial information, synergy trackers, operational data, and performance metrics.

Strong ownership and follow-through; operates independently, anticipates next steps, and keeps workstreams moving between leadership check-ins.

What Will Make This Person Exceptional

They understand where integrations commonly stall—including culture, middle management, IT, systems, and compensation—and help identify issues before they become larger problems.

They can communicate effectively with technical professionals, functional leaders, executives, and external advisors.

They can manage detailed workstream execution while understanding how individual activities contribute to the broader integration strategy.

They bring structure, urgency, and calm judgment to a complex and constantly evolving environment.

Organizational Context
This role reports to the Chief Transformation Officer and works closely with the Integration Management Office, legacy IT leadership, AI program leaders, functional executives, and business-unit leadership.
The Director, Integration does not carry permanent P&L ownership or BU responsibility. Its scope is the integration program itself, with a primary focus on coordination, execution support, reporting, and issue resolution through the platform stabilization horizon. This role offers significant visibility and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution during a pivotal period in the combined firm’s history.

title: Metabolism Investigator
description:
The Morgridge Institute for Research, in partnership with the University of Wisconsin-Madison, seeks a joint tenure track assistant professor to lead a vibrant metabolism-focused research program. We are particularly interested in interdisciplinary and collaborative-minded scientists passionate about mechanistic understanding of metabolism and metabolic regulation, its connections with core biological processes, and innovative approaches to study metabolism. This position will include a joint appointment as an investigator at the Morgridge Institute for Research and as faculty member in one of the potential home departments: the Departments of Chemical & Biological Engineering, Medical Microbiology & Immunology, and Neuroscience at UW-Madison. We welcome investigations of metabolism across diverse physiological and engineering contexts. Areas of

interest across our participating departments include, but are not limited to:


  • Chemical & Biological Engineering: Metabolic engineering, chemical biological technologies in metabolism study, quantitative systems biology.
  • Medical Microbiology & Immunology: Immunometabolism, host-microbe metabolic crosstalk, microbial metabolism.
  • Neuroscience: Neurometabolism, metabolism in the brain, and the metabolic basis of neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative disorders.


This recruitment is part of the Morgridge Institute’s Metabolism Theme and the larger, UW-Madison campus-wide Metabolism Initiative that aims to enhance the pace, productivity, and international profile of metabolism-related research in Madison. The Morgridge Institute is a private interdisciplinary research institute affiliated with UW-Madison, serving as a hub for investigators

affiliated with multiple university departments to work collaboratively on fundamental biomedical questions, and as such offers an extraordinary interdisciplinary work environment. UW-Madison is a world-class academic institution, where the metabolism research community includes hundreds of scientists spanning diverse areas of biochemistry, molecular and cellular biology, organismal biology, and medicine. In keeping with our tradition of collaboration and successful joint appointments, the partnering units in this hire will provide mutual support through substantial facilities, access to colleagues with diverse scientific expertise, high-quality training programs, and other resources -offering a wealth of synergistic benefits.



To Apply: Candidates must hold a doctorate degree (PhD, MD, or equivalent) in related field. Competitive applicants will have a proven track record of high-impact research related to metabolism, a vision for an innovative, significant and impactful research program, the skills to implement it, embrace a collaborative and interdisciplinary research culture, and a commitment to

high quality and inclusive undergraduate and graduate instruction and mentoring. Applicants should submit electronic copies of their curriculum vitae, a 2–3-page description of research vision and future research plans, a 1-page description of teaching philosophy and future teaching plans and should arrange for at least three referees to submit letters of recommendation. Applications should be submitted to metabolism@morgridge.org. To ensure full consideration, applications should be received by November 1, 2026. After this date, applications will be considered on a rolling basis.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We have offices in San Francisco, San Diego and Los Angeles for those who prefer hybrid or office settings. Oura employees in other major cities (like Boston and New York) occasionally gather informally at local co-working locations.

You will be a senior deal-maker, relationship-builder and strategist who turns our Hardware Ecosystem Partnership vision into reality. You’ll own the full partnership life-cycle, from sourcing and structuring deals to orchestrating flawless cross-functional execution with product, engineering, legal, and other relevant teams.

Owns Hardware BD and Partnerships Strategy

    • Deepen member engagement and retention
    • Drive distribution of Oura’s hardware portfolio through “better-together” integrations
    • Unlock new revenue streams for Oura

Close High-Leverage Partnerships Opportunities

  • Drive awareness with partners and members so each integration is recognized and valued, not just available.
  • Position Oura’s hardware partnerships as a differentiated extension of our mission and member experience.

Shape Hardware-Led Differentiation

  • Partner with product, engineering, science, and market leaders on hardware-anchored propositions, movement, powering broader lifestyle capabilities (OEMs, NFC, BLE)
  • Identify where partnerships deepen differentiation and reinforce Oura’s moat
  • Strengthen Oura’s position as the health-sensing platform of choice

Lead, Grow, and Own Outcomes

  • Navigate regulated and health-adjacent categories with legal, clinical, and regulatory partners.
  • Own targets for device-anchored partner launches, attach rates, and ecosystem revenue across priority ICPs.

  • Adoption and usage metrics
  • Launch outcomes and overall experience quality
  • Partner success
  • Define and track KPIs that measure both near-term launch success and long-term portfolio value.

We’d love to have you on the team if you have

title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
description:
Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)

Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?
 Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.
Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.
Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:
• ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
• vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
• ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
• ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
• bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
• werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
• meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
• testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
• signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?
 Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:
  • veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
  • direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
  • veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
  • hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
  • ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
  • werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
  • korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
  • een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
  • een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?
 We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.
Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
  • enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
  • goede kennis van C# en .NET;
  • ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
  • ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
  • ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
  • ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
  • je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
  • je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
  • je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
  • je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken
Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.
Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.
Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.
Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?
 Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.
Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.
Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?
Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

  • Werken met de gaafste automerken!
  • Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
  • Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
  • Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
  • Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken
  • 8,5 medewerkers tevredenheid

title: Director, Field Engineering Strategy & Execution
description:
About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

Role Summary

The Director, Field Engineering Strategy & Execution is the operating partner for the Global Field Engineering organization, embedded within the Office of the CRO's GTM Strategy & Execution function. This role owns the strategic planning, operational cadence, and performance infrastructure that enable the pre-sales/SE (“Field Engineering”) organization to scale efficiently against revenue targets. It translates GTM strategy into Field Engineering execution — capacity planning, coverage models, productivity measurement, tooling, and enablement operations — while acting as the primary strategic advisor to the VP, Global Field Engineering on organizational design and resource allocation.

This is a hybrid role: formal reporting into GTM Strategy & Execution ensures alignment with company-wide revenue planning and cross-functional GTM systems; the strong dotted line into Global Field Engineering ensures the work is grounded in field reality and has direct influence over how the SE organization is run day to day.

Key Responsibilities

Headcount & Capacity Planning

  • Own the Field Engineering headcount model: current-state coverage, ratio benchmarking (SE:AE, SE:ARR, SE:Account), and forward capacity planning tied to pipeline and bookings targets.
  • Partner with Finance and RevOps on annual and in-year headcount requests, backed by data.
  • Build and maintain territory/coverage models across segments, regions, and specializations (e.g., vertical or product-line SE pods).

Performance Operations & Reporting

  • Define and own the Field Engineering KPI framework (e.g., SE utilization, POV win rate, technical win/loss, ramp time, deal-cycle involvement).
  • Build and maintain leadership-facing dashboards and QBR materials for the Global Field Engineering organization.
  • Run the operating cadence: weekly/monthly business reviews, forecast rollups specific to technical validation stages, and escalation processes for at-risk deals requiring SE intervention.

Strategic Planning

  • Translate company and GTM Strategy & Execution priorities into Field Engineering execution plans.
  • Lead annual planning for the Field Engineering org: goals, org structure, budget inputs, and success metrics.
  • Identify structural inefficiencies in field engineering deployment and recommend organizational or process changes.

Systems, Tools & Process

  • Own the Field Engineering tech stack requirements (CRM data model for SE activity, POV/demo tracking, scheduling and capacity tools) in partnership with RevOps and Sales Systems.
  • Standardize and govern SE processes (deal qualification criteria for SE engagement, handoff protocols, POV governance) in partnership with Field Engineering leadership.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled tooling to improve SE productivity and reduce non-selling time.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary liaison between Global Field Engineering and GTM Strategy & Execution, Revenue Operations, Sales, Product, and Finance.
  • Represent Field Engineering's operational needs in company-wide GTM planning cycles (territory carving, comp design, quota setting).
  • Partner with Enablement on the SE certification and skills framework, ensuring it is grounded in capacity and performance data.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in Sales/Revenue Operations, Field Engineering leadership, or GTM Strategy roles, with at least 3+ years in enterprise B2B software or infrastructure/data software.
  • Direct prior experience as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Field Engineer, or as a manager/RevOps partner directly supporting an SE organization.
    Non-negotiable — this role requires firsthand credibility with the field engineering org, not secondhand familiarity.
  • Advanced, hands-on data manipulation and self-serve analytics capability: fluency in a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, or equivalent) and spreadsheet/data modeling at an advanced level (pivot modeling, complex formulas, or scripting in Python/Excel). This person primarily builds their own models and dashboards rather than requesting them from an analyst, although assistance from the Revenue Intelligence team is available when needed (but is secondary).
  • Proven track record building headcount, capacity, and coverage models for a technical pre-sales organization.
  • Strong command of GTM data infrastructure: Salesforce or equivalent CRM, BI/reporting tools, forecasting methodology.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate across a matrixed reporting structure and drive alignment without direct authority.
  • Executive presence: able to present to CRO-level and VP-level stakeholders and hold ground on data-backed recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a company selling technical/developer-oriented products where the SE org is deeply involved in the sales cycle (databases, infrastructure, dev tools, security).
  • Experience standing up or scaling a Field Engineering function through a growth or transformation phase.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted GTM tooling (forecast automation, deal-risk scoring, technical win/loss analysis).
  • Scripting or automation experience (Python, Apps Script) for building recurring reporting pipelines outside of BI-tool constraints.

The annual base salary range for this position based in the United States is listed below. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Neo4j’s compensation practices, job related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and trainings, in addition to geographic location. Based on the factors above, Neo4j utilizes the full width of the range.

Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.

Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.

  • Performs Cardiac Ultrasound Testing (echocardiography)
    • Interacts with and educates patients regarding echocardiography
    • Performs scans; using the M-mode, 2-D (color flow), and Doppler according to established protocol
    • Informs physicians of observations, as needed
    • Completes documentation utilizing echocardiography worksheet
    • Collaborates with RN to perform contrast ECHO study when deemed necessary
    • Ensures documentation of study
    • Utilizes left lateral decubitus position for exam
    • Identifies suboptimal images and utilizes strategies to maximize image quality
    • Maintains performance level of suboptimal exams below established benchmark
    • Ensures timely completion and distribution of dictated and transcribed reports
    • Supports accreditation standards and assists in maintaining ICAEL accreditation status
  • Preparation for Cardiac Stress Testing
    • Interacts with and educates patients regarding cardiac stress test
    • Reinforces and ensures patient understanding of procedure
    • Attaches/disconnects electrodes; prepares set-up of stress testing equipment
    • Obtains blood pressure and assists patients during testing.
    • Records data on assessment sheet
  • Performs Holter Monitor Service
    • Interacts with and educates patients
    • Attaches/disconnects electrodes/monitor
    • Programs Holter monitor and ensures functioning
  • Cardiac Event Monitor
    • Applies and disconnects cardiac event monitors.
    • Provides patient education related to maintenance of monitor and transmission of cardiac events.
    • Manages data in software program and completes report preparation.
  • Associated Duties
    • Assists with quality improvement efforts
    • Develops and conducts education programs in areas of expertise for staff and patients.
    • Performs 12-lead EKG and completes required paperwork and documentation
    • Applies ambulatory blood pressure monitor and provides patient with education related to monitor.
    • Regularly demonstrates the ability to serve patients of all ages in the routine performance of duties.

What You Will Need:

  • Associate Degree in Cardiovascular Technology, or a minimum of 3 years experience in cardiopulmonary specialty procedures.
  • Cardiac Echo certification is required.
  • BLS required.
  • Strong background in cardiopulmonary anatomy, physiology and pathophysiology.
  • Ability to identify cardiac arrhythmias and dysrhythmias.
  • Ability to perform the following cardiopulmonary specialty procedures:
    • Cardiac stress testing preparation
    • 12 lead EKG's
    • Holter monitor application
    • Cardiac event monitor application

title: Sr Information Security Engineer
description:
Position Overview:

This position will serve as a member of the Exostar Information Security Office and will report to the Manager of Governance & Engineering. This role is responsible for designing and implementing technical security controls across application, cloud, identity, and PKI environments. The successful candidate will work directly with DevOps, application, and operations teams to engineer controls and satisfy security framework requirements. This role is ideal for a security engineer who can assess architecture, identify control gaps, implement remediation, and technically validate implementation effectiveness.

This role is ideal for candidates that have a skillset focused on engineering credibility, architectural judgment, and the ability to operate confidently with technical teams, auditors, customers, and leadership.

Responsibilities: Your day if you join us:

Security Architecture & Control Implementation

  • Assess, design, and provide guidance on secure architecture for cloud environments, including IAM, PKI, access, network, and platform services.
  • Engage directly with infrastructure, platform, and development teams to translate security requirements into implementable technical designs and controls.
  • Review proposed system changes, architecture diagrams, network flows, identity integrations, and control implementations for security implications.
  • Develop technical control implementation guidance, including diagrams, control narratives, configuration expectations, and test procedures.
  • Provide hands-on engineering support for control effectiveness through configuration review, evidence inspection, technical testing, log review, and remediation verification.
  • Perform threat modeling and security risk assessments and coordinate actionable mitigation strategies.

Compliance Engineering & Governance

  • Provide engineering support for controls aligned to frameworks such as PKI, identity certification, CMMC L2, FedRAMP Moderate, ISO/IEC 27001, IAM, SOC 2, etc.
  • Produce technical control descriptions that reflect security architecture, implementation, and operational behavior to create defensible control narratives to auditors and customers.
  • Produce SSPs, POA&Ms, control narratives, and audit responses where engineering interpretation is required.
  • Support audits and customer assessments by explaining technical controls, gathering defensible evidence, and validating that evidence against control intent.
  • Improve the repeatability and quality of evidence collection, control validation, and remediation tracking.

Qualifications:

You are a great fit for this role if you:

Required Skills:

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience evaluating secure architecture and implementing security controls in cloud environments.
  • Experience evaluating system architecture, network diagrams, data flows, identity integrations, and technical design documentation.
  • Experience performing threat modeling, technical risk assessments, security design reviews, and control gap assessments.
  • Experience integrating security into the SDLC, including CI/CD pipelines, Agile delivery, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience collaborating with engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, cloud, IAM, and operations teams to drive remediation to closure.
  • Strong understanding of network security concepts, including segmentation, firewalls, proxies, DNS, TLS, VPN/IPSec, routing, ingress/egress control, and secure network design.
  • Experience with identity and access technologies such as Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure AD, SAML, OIDC, MFA, privileged access, role-based access control, and identity federation.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring technical control narratives, technical audit documentation, and supporting evidence.
  • Experience supporting audits and assessments such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to auditors, leadership, and business stakeholders.
  • Significant experience using Jira and Confluence.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
About:

Veda is the DeFi engine powering financial apps enabling platforms to seamlessly create on-chain yield products. Our mission is to unlock DeFi for the world by providing seamless, enterprise-grade integrations for modern finance. Veda's technology powers many of DeFi's largest vault products, including Liquid, PlasmaUSD Vault, Lombard DeFi Vault, and Mantle cmETH.
At $6B in TVL and 100k+ users, Veda is one of the fastest growing DeFi protocols with a team passionate about DeFi and dedicated to our work. This role will be high impact and have the opportunity to directly shape some of the most critical infrastructure in DeFi.

Role:

We’re seeking a Backend Engineer to design, build, and scale the core services powering Veda’s platform. You’ll work across a modern, service-based architecture to deliver reliable, performant systems that power yield products for some of the largest names in DeFi and fintech.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with a strong sense of ownership, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and experienced in taking products from concept to production. You’ll work 70–80% in code, contributing directly to system design, architecture, and implementation.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and build scalable backend systems powering Veda’s API and internal services
  • Own projects end-to-end — from scoping and design to implementation, testing, and production delivery
  • Collaborate with product and infrastructure teams to turn technical debt into modern, maintainable, and highly available systems
  • Write clean, well-tested code, and maintain strong CI/CD hygiene
  • Deploy, monitor, and scale services in production using modern cloud tooling (AWS, GCP, or similar)
  • Contribute to system design discussions covering performance, reliability, and data architecture
  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for production systems
  • Continuously identify and drive improvements in system reliability, observability, and performance

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of professional backend engineering experience
  • Proven experience delivering production systems end-to-end (scoping → design → implementation → production)
  • Strong programming skills in Python or another modern backend language (e.g., Go, Rust, Java, C++)
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, relational databases (Postgres or MySQL), and service-based architectures
  • Experience with version control (Git), unit/integration testing, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience participating in an on-call rotation or owning production systems
  • Demonstrated ability to design scalable systems and refactor legacy components

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or other high-availability systems
  • Familiarity with asynchronous task queues, event-driven architecture, or distributed systems design
  • Prior experience in startups or early-stage, high-ambiguity environments
  • Contributions to open-source projects or technical leadership on significant internal initiatives

Benefits at Veda

We’re a small, tight-knit team building the infrastructure that powers a new generation of financial products - on-chain, composable, and accessible to anyone. We believe the full potential of DeFi is still ahead of us, and we’re here to help unlock it.
We also believe that great work comes from people who feel trusted, supported, and aligned with the mission. Here’s how we try to make that happen:

Health Coverage

We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees. For international contractors, we work closely to ensure access to appropriate local or global health coverage.

Flexible Time Off

We don’t track vacation days. Take the time you need to rest and recharge—we trust you to manage your schedule.

Remote-First by Design

Our team spans time zones and geographies. We work async, with a focus on autonomy over micromanagement.

Parental Leave

Paid leave is available for new parents, whether you’re the primary or secondary caregiver.

Learning & Development

We offer stipends to support ongoing learning - whether it’s a course, a conference, or something else that helps you grow.

title: Senior C/C++ Engineer
description:
The Senior C/C++ Engineer sits within Omilia's product engineering team, building and maintaining performance-critical systems software that underpins Omilia's conversational AI infrastructure. The role requires strong systems-level programming fundamentals and, ideally, prior exposure to telephony or real-time communications stacks such as Asterisk-based voice platforms, SIP signaling, and dialplan engineering. It is structured to let a strong C/C++ engineer grow into deep telephony specialization over time, with mentorship available from the team's existing SIP experts. Engineers who already bring that expertise are fast-tracked into the specialized workstreams.

Accountabilities

  • Own the design, development, and ongoing support of performance-critical C/C++ components across Omilia's platform.
  • Own resolution of scalability and performance issues affecting telephony and SIP systems.
  • Ensure effective time management and consistent delivery against deadlines.
  • Contribute as an integrated, collaborative team member across engineering and cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain C/C++ components across Omilia's platform, with emphasis on performance, memory safety, and concurrency correctness in production systems.
  • Develop efficient applications for mission-critical systems geared for high availability and performance.
  • Debug complex, multi-threaded, low-level issues using tools such as gdb, valgrind, and/or strace.
  • Develop, extend, and maintain custom Asterisk modules (res_, chan_, app_*) to support call handling, recording, and routing requirements specific to the platform.
  • Patch, rebuild, and validate Asterisk core and third-party modules against upstream security advisories and internal hardening requirements.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and suggest improvements.
  • Develop with security principles in mind and scale services with a DevOps mindset.
  • Meet regularly with the line manager to review progress; manage issue resolution and escalate critically when needed.
  • Work effectively with other teams, units, and departments, ensuring clear information flow and team working.
  • Support other organisational priority activities when necessary, and act as an Omilia ambassador.

Requirements

Required:

  • 5+ years professional experience in C/C++ systems programming, including memory management, multithreading, and low-level debugging.
  • Experience with Git and C/C++ build systems such as CMake or Meson.
  • Hands-on experience modifying, compiling, and deploying Asterisk.
  • Experience writing APIs and/or Web Services & Microservices using C/C++.
  • Object-oriented analysis and design using common design patterns.
  • Self-motivated and driven to create extraordinary things.
  • Ability to work under pressure and on strict deadlines.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science.
  • Very good written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Continuous innovation mindset.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of SIP (RFC 3261) and related RFCs (SDP, RTP/RTCP, STUN/TURN/ICE) and practical dialplan authoring experience.
  • Experience with Java or Python programming.
  • Familiarity with FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, or OpenSIPS, WebRTC-to-SIP interworking, or call recording/audio codec architectures (G.711, G.729, Opus).
  • Experience in regulated environments (PCI-DSS, HIPAA) where call recording and redaction requirements apply.

Benefits

  • Fixed compensation;
  • Long-term employment with the working days vacation;
  • Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);
  • Being part of successful cutting-edge technology products that are making a global impact in the service industry;
  • Proficient and fun-to-work-with colleagues;

title: Network Operations Engineer
description:
The Role:
11:11 is looking for a Network Operations Engineer whose primary responsibility will be to assist with providing 24/7 monitoring, technical support, implementation, and escalation for our global network infrastructure with a focus on 11:11 Systems Connectivity Solutions and Managed Network Solutions. We are looking for someone who is a team player, detail oriented, and has excellent customer service skills with a solid hands-on technical background as a Network Engineer in previous roles. Both written and verbal communication skills are critical to this role.
This is a full-time remote role, based in the United States, reporting to the Manager, Network Operations.

Responsibilities:
• Assist with the configuration, installation, maintenance, and upgrade of Fortinet, Cisco and Palo Alto next generation firewall devices supporting 11:11 customers and internal network infrastructure.
• Support existing customer facing networks and assist senior engineers with network expansion, hardware refresh, and connectivity solution efforts.
• Implement system and network configurations in compliance with corporate security policies and security best practices.
• Support technology solutions, such as SDWAN, MPLS, Wired and Wireless Connectivity solutions (Layer 2 and Layer 3), Firewalls, Routers, Switches, and Load Balancers in accordance with best practices and company policies.
• Perform day-to-day lifecycle management of Cradlepoint wireless edge devices via Ericsson NetCloud Manager (formerly NetCloud ECM), including device onboarding and provisioning, configuration group management, NetCloud OS firmware upgrades, and licensing/subscription tracking.
• Provide break/fix support and change management for Cradlepoint deployments, including troubleshooting cellular (LTE/5G) WAN connectivity and carrier-related issues, coordinating hardware RMAs, and implementing configuration changes through NetCloud Manager in accordance with established change control processes.
• Provide multi-layered technical support to our customer base using services supported through our Network Operations Center.
• Review and resolve anomalies that are potentially service impacting. Escalate to senior engineering resources or management if necessary.
• Escalate complex customer issues to senior engineering resources while maintaining ownership through resolution.
• Serve as a liaison with customers, vendors, and other third-party providers to troubleshoot issues.
• Accurately track issues in the ticketing system while providing timely updates to customers on progress and resolutions.
• Obtain and maintain technical certifications to further knowledge of products and services offered by the company.
• Work supportively with colleagues, operating in a manner that is consistent with 11:11’s Code of Business Ethics and Company Values.
• Responsibly receive, transmit, and handle company data and information per Company data handling agreements, work procedures and policies.
• Review and follow company policies and guidelines, data privacy practices, including annual compliance training certification and policy acknowledgements.

• Additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's or University degree in a related field of study or an equivalent 5+ years of related work experience required.
• Solid understanding of the OSI model with hands-on network troubleshooting experience using debug commands, packet captures, and routing and path analysis.
• Hands-on experience with configuration and troubleshooting of Cisco ASA/Firepower and Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center, Fortinet FortiGate Firewalls and Fortinet Product Suite including Fortinet Access-Points and Fortinet Switches.
• Experience with Cisco Routers and Switches; exposure to Cisco Nexus Switches preferred.
• Familiarity with Juniper Switches (EX/QFX), Routers, and Firewalls (SRX).
• Familiarity with Palo Alto Firewalls and Panorama.
• Experience supporting and troubleshooting SD-WAN environments, with hands-on exposure to FortiGate SD-WAN implementations.
• Experience with configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting of Cradlepoint routers and wireless WAN solutions managed through Ericsson NetCloud Manager, including cellular (LTE/5G) connectivity troubleshooting.
• Working knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) with hands-on troubleshooting experience; exposure to IS-IS a plus.
• Familiarity with load balancers a plus; F5 (LTM/GTM) experience preferred.
• Exposure to VMware NSX-V and NSX-T a plus.
• Working knowledge of MPLS concepts and troubleshooting.
• Strong experience troubleshooting Layer 2 and Layer 3 issues.
• Exposure to AWS networking services (VPC, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect, Security Groups, NACLs) a plus.
• Exposure to Cloudflare services (DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS protection, Zero Trust/Access, Tunnel) a plus.
• Demonstrated customer focus with strong customer service skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take ownership of incidents and drive them through to resolution in a 24/7 operations environment.
• Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a team setting, including working across shifts and time zones and sharing knowledge with peers.
• Demonstrated learning agility and adaptability, with a willingness to acquire new skills and technologies as the network and customer needs evolve.
• Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE (e.g., NSE 4), Palo Alto PCNSE, or Cradlepoint certifications are preferred but not required.
• Must be legally eligible to work in assigned country without visa sponsorship.

Physical Requirements:
This is a primarily remote role that requires the ability to work for extended periods of time using a computer, keyboard, mouse, and standard office software and communication tools. The role requires the ability to participate in frequent virtual meetings (audio and video) and to communicate clearly in both written and verbal form. The position may require occasional work during evenings, nights, weekends, or holidays to support a 24/7 operations environment. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Compensation and Benefits at 11:11 Systems

The base salary for this role ranges from $ 74,00 to $ 83,000.

These ranges are informed by market data, internal equity, and qualifications required by job level. Actual pay is based on multiple factors, including skills, experience, certifications, and location.

Individuals may also be eligible for variable incentives such as bonuses or sales commissions, which are also based on level and position within the organization. Additional company-sponsored benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Comprehensive healthcare plan options
  • Retirement plan with company match

title: Head of Commercial
description:
About Bosta:

Launched in 2017, Bosta is an overnight delivery provider for E-commerce companies in Egypt. Leveraging technology to empower businesses is what we do best. Our goal is to disrupt the logistics industry by bringing technology and experience all together to provide a one-stop-shop for delivery solutions.
We rely on advanced technology to deliver orders to our customers in a fast way. Businesses can track and connect with couriers and follow up on their orders - all in one system.

About the role:

The Head of Commercial will be responsible for leading and accelerating Bosta’s commercial growth across Egypt, owning the overall commercial strategy, sales performance, market expansion, revenue growth, and customer portfolio development.

The role will be accountable for identifying where Bosta should grow, how fast it should grow, and what commercial strategy, resources, products, pricing, and go-to-market approach are required to achieve that growth.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, highly analytical and data-oriented commercial leader who can combine strong commercial judgment with deep understanding of market dynamics, customer behavior, competitive movements, and operational capabilities.

This person must be able to translate data into insights, insights into strategy, and strategy into measurable growth.

Job Responsibilities:

1. COMMERCIAL STRATEGY & BUSINESS GROWTH

  • Own and execute Bosta’s overall commercial growth strategy across Egypt, aligned with the company’s long-term vision and financial objectives.
  • Develop clear annual, quarterly and monthly commercial plans covering shipment volumes, revenue, customer acquisition, retention, market expansion and profitability.
  • Identify the key growth levers required to achieve Bosta’s business ambitions and translate them into measurable commercial initiatives.
  • Define the right balance between organic growth, new customer acquisition, existing customer growth, new verticals, new products and geographic expansion.
  • Continuously assess Bosta’s commercial performance against plan and take corrective action when required.
  • Build different growth scenarios and business cases to support strategic decision-making.

2. MARKET EXPANSION & GEOGRAPHIC GROWTH

  • Own Bosta’s commercial expansion strategy across Egypt, identifying priority cities, regions, customer segments and industries for growth.
  • Analyze market potential, e-commerce penetration, merchant density, shipment potential, competitive landscape and economic dynamics to identify the highest-value growth opportunities.
  • Develop market-entry and expansion plans, including required sales capacity, customer acquisition targets, pricing strategy and commercial resources.
  • Determine where Bosta should invest ahead of demand and where resources should be concentrated to maximize return.
  • Build a structured view of the Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM), and Bosta’s penetration across key markets.
  • Monitor competitor movements, pricing, service offerings and market share to ensure Bosta remains commercially competitive.

3. VOLUME PLANNING, FORECASTING & COMMERCIAL INTELLIGENCE

  • Own the commercial forecasting process and provide accurate forecasts for daily, weekly, monthly and annual shipment volumes and revenue.
  • Build robust forecasting models based on historical performance, pipeline, customer behavior, seasonality, market trends and commercial initiatives.
  • Continuously evaluate forecast accuracy and improve forecasting methodologies.
  • Identify future volume gaps early and create action plans to close them.
  • Translate the company’s growth ambitions into clear sales capacity, customer acquisition and volume requirements.
  • Develop scenario planning for different growth trajectories, market conditions and business assumptions.
  • Provide leadership with a clear view of where the business is today, where it is going, and what needs to happen to reach the target.

4. SALES & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the Sales and Telesales organizations to consistently deliver acquisition, shipment and revenue targets.
  • Develop the commercial organization’s go-to-market strategy, sales coverage model, segmentation and resource allocation.
  • Establish clear productivity targets and performance standards across the sales organization.
  • Build a healthy and predictable sales pipeline with clear visibility on conversion, expected volumes and timing.
  • Continuously analyze sales productivity, conversion rates, pipeline coverage, customer acquisition cost and salesperson performance.
  • Ensure sales resources are deployed against the highest-potential markets, segments and customers.
  • Develop strategic partnerships and major commercial opportunities that can materially accelerate Bosta’s growth.

5. CUSTOMER PORTFOLIO & REVENUE GROWTH

  • Drive sustainable growth from Bosta’s existing customer base through retention, volume growth, upselling and cross-selling.
  • Develop strategies to increase customer lifetime value and wallet share.
  • Identify high-value customers and segments requiring dedicated commercial strategies.
  • Monitor churn, retention, customer growth, shipment concentration and profitability.
  • Build early-warning mechanisms to identify potential volume decline or customer churn before it impacts the business.
  • Balance acquisition and retention to ensure growth is both high-quality and sustainable.

6. DATA, ANALYTICS & DECISION MAKING

  • Establish a highly data-driven commercial culture where major decisions are supported by facts, analytics and measurable business cases.
  • Own the commercial performance framework and ensure leadership has clear visibility of the key business KPIs.
  • Analyze shipment trends, revenue, ASP, conversion, retention, churn, customer productivity, sales productivity, profitability and market penetration.
  • Identify the “why” behind the numbers, not simply report performance.
  • Turn complex analytical insights into clear commercial actions and measurable outcomes.
  • Work closely with Data, Finance, Operations and Technology teams to improve business intelligence and commercial decision-making.
  • Leverage automation, AI and advanced analytics to improve forecasting, customer segmentation, sales productivity and commercial planning.

7. PRICING & PROFITABILITY

  • Own the commercial approach to pricing, discounting and customer economics in partnership with Finance and relevant stakeholders.
  • Balance growth, competitiveness and profitability when designing commercial offers.
  • Monitor ASP, contribution margin, discounts and customer profitability.
  • Identify margin leakage and opportunities to improve revenue quality.
  • Develop differentiated commercial models based on customer value, volume, segment and profitability.

8. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL BUSINESS LEADERSHIP

  • Partner closely with Operations, Finance, Product, Technology and Data to ensure commercial growth is supported by the required operational and technological capabilities.
  • Translate commercial ambitions into operational requirements and capacity planning.
  • Ensure the organization is prepared ahead of major growth periods, market expansions and commercial initiatives.
  • Act as the commercial voice in major company-wide strategic decisions.
  • Build strong alignment between commercial strategy and Bosta’s overall business strategy.

9. LEADERSHIP & ORGANIZATION DEVELOPMENT

  • Lead, develop and coach a high-performing commercial organization.
  • Build a culture of ownership, accountability, performance, analytical thinking and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure the organization has the right structure, talent, incentives and capabilities to support Bosta’s growth ambitions.
  • Develop future commercial leaders and build strong succession plans.
  • Establish performance management and incentive structures that drive sustainable growth.

KEY SUCCESS MEASURES

  • Shipment volume growth
  • Revenue growth
  • Market penetration and share
  • New customer acquisition
  • Existing customer volume growth
  • Customer retention and churn
  • Sales productivity and conversion
  • Forecast accuracy
  • ASP and revenue quality
  • Customer profitability and contribution margin
  • Geographic and vertical expansion
  • Commercial ROI
  • Overall achievement of Bosta’s strategic growth plan

Job Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in commercial leadership, preferably within e-commerce, logistics, technology, FMCG, marketplaces or other high-growth businesses.
  • Proven track record of delivering significant business and revenue growth.
  • Highly data-oriented, analytical and commercially minded.
  • Strong experience in business planning, forecasting and translating data into commercial decisions.
  • Understands market dynamics and can identify changes in customer behavior, competition and market opportunities before they materially impact the business.
  • Can build a clear view of market potential and translate it into actionable growth plans.
  • Comfortable working with large datasets, dashboards, BI tools, CRM systems and forecasting models.
  • Strong financial and P&L understanding.
  • Able to challenge assumptions and make decisions based on facts rather than intuition alone.
  • Excellent strategic planning and execution capabilities.
  • Can operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ambiguity and changing market conditions.
  • Strong leadership, negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Strong technology and AI mindset and understands how emerging technologies can improve commercial performance.
Thank you for considering Bosta as your next career step. We value every application we receive, and our selection process is designed to ensure the best fit for both our team and our candidates. We appreciate your patience throughout the process

title: Security Manager
description:
Position Title: Security Manager

Department: Technology

Reports To: VP of IT

Location: Chicago / Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role:

We're looking for a hands-on Security Manager to own our organization's day-to-day security posture — across our people, endpoints, software, and vendors. This role sits at the intersection of governance, technical security operations, and emerging AI risk. You'll be the person who knows where our exposure is, who's using what, and whether our controls actually hold up under testing.


We need someone comfortable both setting standards and getting into the weeds — reviewing a vendor's SOC 2 report one hour, scoping a vulnerability scan the next, and evaluating whether a new AI tool an employee wants to use is safe to approve.


What You'll Do:


Employee & Endpoint Security

  • Monitor employee security practices, device compliance, and adherence to internal security policies
  • Maintain visibility into laptops, mobile devices, and endpoints — encryption status, EDR/antivirus coverage, and configuration drift
  • Manage identity and access controls (least privilege, MFA, offboarding, privileged access reviews)
  • Run security awareness training and phishing simulations
  • Software & Shadow IT Oversight
  • Maintain an inventory of software and SaaS tools in use across the organization, including unsanctioned ("shadow IT") applications
  • Evaluate and approve new software and AI tools before adoption, assessing data handling, permissions, and vendor risk
  • Track license and application sprawl as a security (not just cost) issue

AI Security

  • Stay current on AI-specific risks: prompt injection, data leakage through AI tools, model/vendor data retention policies, unsanctioned use of generative AI on sensitive data, and supply-chain risk in AI-powered products
  • Develop and enforce acceptable-use policies for AI tools and copilots
  • Assess AI vendors and features embedded in existing software (e.g., new AI features rolled into SaaS products) for security implications

Third-Party & Vendor Risk

  • Conduct vendor security assessments and due diligence before and during engagements
  • Review vendor security documentation (SOC 2, ISO 27001 certifications, penetration test summaries, security questionnaires)
  • Maintain a third-party risk register and reassess periodically based on criticality and data access

Technical Security Operations

  • Coordinate or perform vulnerability scanning across infrastructure, endpoints, and applications
  • Manage or oversee penetration testing engagements (internal team or external vendors), track findings through remediation
  • Perform cyber risk assessments across systems, business units, and processes
  • Support incident response: detection, triage, containment, and post-incident review

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Maintain and mature the security program in alignment with frameworks such as NIST CSF/800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2
  • Ensure practices support compliance with data privacy regulations including GDPR and CCPA/CPRA
  • Own or contribute to security policies, standards, and audit readiness
  • Report on security posture, risk, and metrics to leadership

title: Information Security Engineer
description:
Position Overview:

This position will serve as a member of the Exostar Information Security Office and will report to the Manager of Governance & Engineering. This role is responsible for designing and implementing technical security controls across application, cloud, identity, and PKI environments. The successful candidate will work directly with DevOps, application, and operations teams to engineer controls and satisfy security framework requirements. This role is ideal for a security engineer who can assess architecture, identify control gaps, implement remediation, and technically validate implementation effectiveness.

This role is ideal for candidates that have a skillset focused on engineering credibility, architectural judgment, and the ability to operate confidently with technical teams, auditors, customers, and leadership.

Responsibilities: Your day if you join us:

Security Architecture & Control Implementation

  • Assess, design, and provide guidance on secure architecture for cloud environments, including IAM, PKI, access, network, and platform services.
  • Engage directly with infrastructure, platform, and development teams to translate security requirements into implementable technical designs and controls.
  • Review proposed system changes, architecture diagrams, network flows, identity integrations, and control implementations for security implications.
  • Develop technical control implementation guidance, including diagrams, control narratives, configuration expectations, and test procedures.
  • Provide hands-on engineering support for control effectiveness through configuration review, evidence inspection, technical testing, log review, and remediation verification.
  • Perform threat modeling and security risk assessments and coordinate actionable mitigation strategies.

Compliance Engineering & Governance

  • Provide engineering support for controls aligned to frameworks such as PKI, identity certification, CMMC L2, FedRAMP Moderate, ISO/IEC 27001, IAM, SOC 2, etc.
  • Produce technical control descriptions that reflect security architecture, implementation, and operational behavior to create defensible control narratives to auditors and customers.
  • Produce SSPs, POA&Ms, control narratives, and audit responses where engineering interpretation is required.
  • Support audits and customer assessments by explaining technical controls, gathering defensible evidence, and validating that evidence against control intent.
  • Improve the repeatability and quality of evidence collection, control validation, and remediation tracking.

Qualifications:

You are a great fit for this role if you:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience evaluating secure architecture and implementing security controls in cloud environments.
  • Experience evaluating system architecture, network diagrams, data flows, identity integrations, and technical design documentation.
  • Experience performing threat modeling, technical risk assessments, security design reviews, and control gap assessments.
  • Experience integrating security into the SDLC, including CI/CD pipelines, Agile delivery, and DevSecOps practices.

  • Experience supporting audits and assessments such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to auditors, leadership, and business stakeholders.

  • U.S. Citizens only- Due to customer requirements, U.S. Citizenship is required. Ability to gain and maintain Trusted Role is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CISSP and other similar technical certifications
  • Experience implementing Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tools

location: Banner Research (10515 W Sante Fe Dr)
description:
Primary City/State:

Sun City, Arizona

Department Name:

Neuropsychology-Rsrch

Day

Job Category:

Clinical Care

The Research Institute Brain and Body Donation Program – Sun City serves all aspects of the Institute’s mission – to make a difference to patients with age-related disorders through cutting-edge research, clinical care, prevention, and education. The Neuropsychology team includes neuropsychologists, psychometrists, research assistants, post-doctoral fellows, and psychology graduate students. Our team is dedicated to precision and accuracy in administration of neuropsychological measures, compassionate care for our patients and research participants, and collaborative innovation of best practices.

The Psychometrist administers and scores standardized cognitive and neuropsychological tests. Assessments take place in diverse contexts, including government- and industry-sponsored research and clinical trials, local and national research consortiums, community-based cognitive screenings, and outpatient clinical evaluations. The psychometrists work closely with the neuropsychologists and under their supervision. Neuropsychologists are always there to help, support, and educate. Research opportunities are available for someone who is planning to study further in graduate school or medical school. Those with two or more years of clinical or cognitive assessment experience — or related educational background — are encouraged to apply, and any research experience is a welcomed plus!

As a member of our team, you will also be engaged in our robust training program, which teaches the next generation of neuropsychologists (graduate students and post-doctoral fellows). The Neuropsychology Center is also called upon for sharing our expertise in cognitive assessment with colleagues across various departments.

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8am to 4:30pm

Location: Banner Research 10515 W Santa Fe Dr Sun City, AZ

Banner Alzheimer's Institute (BAI) was established in 2006 as Banner Health's first Center of Excellence. Banner Sun Health Research Institute (BSHRI) was founded in 1986. Our team is uniquely, passionately, and strategically committed to ending Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders without losing another generation, advancing oncology research to improve cancer prevention and treatment outcomes, and providing an unparalleled model of care for families facing these devastating diseases. Banner Research is committed to improving people's lives through comprehensive patient care and advances that capitalize on the best biomedical research. We intend to make a transformational difference in Alzheimer's disease, other neurodegenerative disorders, and oncology research and care.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position administers and scores various cognitive and neuropsychological tests under the supervision of a neuropsychologist. This position attends training for specific clinical trial and/or research protocols and administers neuropsychological testing in accordance with protocols to ensure validity of testing.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Administers cognitive and neuropsychological tests utilizing a set test battery. Establishes rapport and maintains flexibility when interacting with patients/participants who are at varying levels of impairment. Uses judgment in determining patient's/participant's ability to complete testing. Provides appropriate direction and instruction to patients/participants in the administration of testing without compromising testing validity.

2. Scores evaluations and provides normative/standardized scoring for each measure. Provides observational summary which may include reference to patient/participant behavioral information, effort level, degree of redirection required. For certain evaluations, enters test data into computer database ensuring accuracy and entry in a timely manner.

3. Attends training provided by research sponsors to understand study protocols, administration and scoring procedures. Administers testing with a high level of attention to detail and with strict adherence to study protocols and procedures in order to provide valid test results.

4. Organizes and inventories protocols, forms, and test stimuli. Ensure that adequate supplies are available.

5. May assist in training intern students in the proper administration and scoring of instruments, along with the varied nuances of testing including behavioral observations, effort and validity of assessment, and rapport-building with patient/participant.

6. May be responsible for supervision of staff.

7. This position interacts with department staff, physicians, patients, clinical trial/research participants, clinical trial/research sponsors. Position requires clinical judgment in assessing patient/participant's ability to provide testing responses to ensure valid testing environment/results. Must provide strict adherence to established protocols and structured evaluations.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's Degree in psychology, behavioral health or a related field.

Requires excellent attention to detail and must be able to follow protocols to provide valid testing environment and results. Requires excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Requires ability to establish rapport with clients with varying degrees of impairment and to obtain optimal and valid testing results.

Requires ability to utilize computer database for maintaining test results.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Master's degree in psychology or behavioral health related field preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.
