title: Member Service Representative
description:
Join the Mountainside Fitness Team

About the Role


We’re looking for a friendly, energetic, and motivated individual to join our team as a Member Service Representative at Mountainside Fitness— an upscale health club where members and employees feel welcomed, valued, and supported. As a Member Service Representative, you’ll be one of the first faces our members and guests see, creating a welcoming atmosphere while providing outstanding customer service. You’ll assist with member needs, answer questions, give tours, promote memberships and club services, and confidently identify sales opportunities. If you’re personable, goal-driven, and enjoy connecting with people while helping them reach their fitness goals,


Why Mountainside Fitness?

We invest in our people. Here's what you can expect as part of the Mountainside family:

  • Complimentary gym membership plus deep personal training discounts
  • Onsite childcare — bring your own kids to work with you
  • Consistent schedules that stay the same week to week — no surprises
  • Flexible pay for hourly employees — access your earnings when you need them
  • Real growth opportunities — 100% of our General Managers were promoted from within


RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES — SALES SPECIFIC


Data & Prospect Management

  • Enter data accurately and effectively into the computer system.
  • Tour, contact, and enter every prospect into the system. Maintain communication with prospects until the sale is complete.
  • Document all customer communication in Hub Spot and record follow-ups to verify contact. MSRs will use the company phone for all outreach.


Sales Performance Standards

  • The MSR role at Mountainside Fitness is competitive. Schedules, goals, and performance metrics change monthly — MSRs must consistently meet sales criteria. Performance is measured across:
  • Number of sales per pay period.
  • Prospect-to-sales closing ratios.
  • Training Package sales.
  • Meeting or exceeding monthly sales goals: BE, Income, Personal Training, and other stated goals.
  • Performance during Secret Shopper visits.
  • Number of self-generated prospects — employee's ability to drive traffic into the club.
  • Availability, dependability, and ability to improve the sales team at their specific location.


Closing Ratio Requirement: MSRs are expected to maintain a 70% or higher closing ratio. Example — if you tour 10 prospects, 7 should be sold. Ratios are calculated on a monthly basis only. Example: In August, Johnny Membership sold 20 memberships and had 30 outstanding prospects — a closing ratio of 67%. Four consecutive pay periods below the 70% minimum will result in progressive discipline, which may include suspension, loss of sales shifts, or termination.

  • Sales goals are set monthly by the club manager or District Manager. Total sales per period compared to the sales goal is the primary measure of sales performance.
  • MSRs are expected to sell Personal Training at a rate of 15% of their sole BEs.


Secret Shopper & Professionalism

  • Clubs and MSRs will be visited sporadically by corporate Secret Shopper personnel. MSRs are expected to perform professionally, remain service-minded, and express the desire to start the guest on a membership that same day.
  • MSRs are expected to work honestly and fairly with the sales staff and be available to pick up additional shifts when needed.


Training & Development

  • MSRs are expected to attend MSF-sponsored continuing education and sales technique improvement sessions at least once per quarter.
  • MSRs are expected to initiate a monthly tour with their GM or DM. The tour will include role play, closing techniques, and sales methods such as "Discovering the Prospect."

title: Vertical Video Supervising Producer
description:
About MPU

More Perfect Union is an advocacy, journalism, and education organization with a mission to build power for the working class. Since launching in February 2021, More Perfect Union’s Emmy award-winning coverage has garnered 8 million followers and subscribers. We are the fastest growing news/politics YouTube channel.

About the Position

The Vertical Video Supervising Producer will co-lead the vertical video team, under direction of the Director of Audience Engagement. This position’s primary responsibility is to both manage the creator program and ensure timely production of short vertical videos that tap into current and emerging events in the news cycle.

The Vertical Video Supervising Producer role requires a high-level of self-sufficiency, strong management skills and the ability to recognize and respond to relevant news quickly. This position will manage our creator program, editors, and vertical producers in conjunction with the other Vertical Supervising Producer to identify emerging news and produce relevant video content on short timelines.

The Vertical Video Supervising Producer will oversee the conceptualization, scripting, producing, and editing of short, news-driven videos. They must have significant experience scripting, producing and editing news-driven videos with the technical and narrative skills to create powerful stories that hook viewers and keep people watching. The position requires management experience, self-sufficiency, strong collaboration and communication skills, and a strong understanding of More Perfect Union’s editorial lens.

Core Responsibilities

  • Report to and work with the Director of Audience Engagement to plan and execute vertical, news-driven video content.
  • Manage producers, creator lead and editors on the Vertical Video team, supporting their professional growth and ensuring the team meets publication deadlines, editorial standards, and performance goals
  • Provide editorial and production guidance to creator leads for creator-driven content, and ensure that videos meet a high standard for substantive, timely reporting
  • Work closely with the other Vertical Supervising Producer to oversee the vertical video team, manage editorial priorities, and ensure the team operates as one cohesive unit
  • Work closely with the Director of Audience Engagement and Editor in Chief to assign stories, approve pitches, and shape stories in conjunction with producers and creator leads
  • Oversee all aspects of video creation with producers, creator leads, and editors: planning shoots, ideating visual concepts, reviewing outlines, interview questions, and shot lists, as well as reviewing scripts and edits.
  • Ensure publishing schedule is up to date, projects are on target, and publishing goals are met.
  • Coordinate with the social media team to plan distribution and engagement strategies such as copy and on-screen titles
  • Hire and work with freelance producers and editors to execute videos as necessary
  • Ensure contracts are sent for freelance producers and editors and work is completed on schedule
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet expected deadlines
  • Maintain high standard of work in a nimble, fast paced environment
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Experience/Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in advocacy, news, and relevant video communications roles.
  • Minimum 2 years of management experience.
  • Strong understanding of issues affecting the working class, the economic justice advocacy space, and the new media landscape.
  • Familiarity with digital content creation and production, Adobe Creative Cloud, and current social media analytics platforms.
  • The ability to stay up to date with the news cycle and add a new lens on trending stories, a desire to lead the news cycle, and passion for creating media narratives that empower the working class.
  • Proficiency in social media management, editorial calendars, and content management systems.
  • Understanding of content analytics tools and data-driven decision making.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and project management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

title: Head of Engineering - Data Products
description:
The purpose of this role is to understand, model and facilitate change in a significant area of the business and technology portfolio either by line of business, geography or specific architecture domain whilst building the overall Architecture capability and knowledge base of the company.

Job Description:

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Engineering to own the technical roadmap for our enterprise-scale data and AI infrastructure. You will lead a multi-disciplinary engineering organisation, set data platform and cloud architecture direction, and act as the bridge between hands-on solution design and commercial/vendor accountability. This role combines strong architectural credibility with people leadership, governance ownership, and stakeholder management across global clients.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, grow and develop a multi-disciplinary engineering organisation, providing mentorship to Development Leads and engineers, ensuring team composition is adequate, and hiring to fill gaps.
  • Set and own the technical roadmap for the data platform, defining reference architectures and design patterns (e.g. medallion/layered architectures) that scale across multiple business units and data domains.
  • Provide guidance, coaching and mentorship in modern data engineering practices, web application development, and best practices for diagnostics, debugging, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting.
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to scope, plan and estimate the technical roadmap, aligning it to broader business goals and helping to forecast delivery timescales.
  • Evaluate solution options against business requirements and organisational standards; champion rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept work to validate designs and de-risk delivery.
  • Provide architectural oversight and mentorship to architects and engineers; maintain high standards of design documentation and contribute to the evolution of architectural reference models.
  • Foster constructive debates between Product, Engineering and UX teams to create scalable, client-focused solutions that solve business problems with software in the shortest sustainable lead-time.
  • Establish and run governance frameworks for applications and data products, including certification and stewardship processes; ensure compliance with security, data privacy, and regulatory standards.
  • Own platform security posture: access control, secrets management, naming/tagging conventions, and certification of new data products. Lead the triage and remediation of platform security or data incidents.
  • Build visibility into cloud and compute cost drivers; drive FinOps practices to optimise spend across environments. Design repeatable onboarding processes for new tools, analysts, and integrations.
  • Manage vendor relationships, procurement processes and commercial contract negotiations, ensuring legal and compliance requirements are met. Provide technical oversight of 3rd party supplier partnerships.
  • Lead platform modernisation and migration programmes, including planning, sequencing, and risk management for large-scale technology transitions.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, assessing their potential impact and benefit to the overall business strategy, particularly AI/agentic capabilities and data infrastructure innovations.

Candidate Profile

  • Proven experience leading data engineering or data platform teams at a senior/head level, ideally within a large or matrixed organisation.
  • Industry experience working with Data platforms is essential, with strong background in dimensional data modelling, data pipeline development and data engineering in support of web applications.
  • Strong hands-on background in modern cloud data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent) and major cloud providers (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Solid understanding of data governance, access control, and security practices in cloud environments.
  • Experience with large-scale ETL/ELT design and migration programmes.
  • Familiarity with how AI/ML and agentic systems are integrated with enterprise data platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud cost management and FinOps practices.
  • Experience managing vendor contracts, procurement, and commercial negotiations.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences and global/matrixed teams.
  • A structured, specification-driven approach to requirements and delivery, with a preference for disciplined, release-oriented delivery.
  • Able to demonstrate evidence of applying technology to solve business problems.

Essential Skills

  • Strong working knowledge of modern cloud data platforms (Azure Databricks/Spark using Python and associated frameworks, or Snowflake equivalent).
  • Familiarity with how AI/ML and agentic systems are integrated with enterprise data platforms.
  • Strong working knowledge of cloud storage solutions (Azure Data Lake, Blob storage, or equivalent

title: Associate DevOps Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities

Your day if you join us:

  • Develop and enhance full stack applications that support automation, deployment, and internal developer tooling.
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools to streamline software delivery.
  • Write scripts and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, or Python to automate cloud provisioning and operational tasks.
  • Collaborate with peers onsite in real-time to debug issues, design solutions, and deliver working software in a fast-paced environment.
  • Learn new technologies on the fly and adapt quickly to project needs, using Generative AI tools like GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT to accelerate development.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and agile ceremonies, contributing actively to team deliverables.
  • Support the monitoring and observability of automation solutions, ensuring performance, traceability, and availability.
  • Help document processes, tools, and learnings to improve team productivity and onboarding for future engineers.
  • Take ownership of tasks and demonstrate a bias for action, even when working in unfamiliar areas.

Required Qualifications

You meet our “must haves” for this role if you have:

  • 1–3 years of experience in software development, DevOps, or related technical roles, including internships or personal projects.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, JavaScript, Java, or .NET.
  • Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Codex) to write, refactor, or troubleshoot code.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI, and a basic understanding of modern software delivery pipelines.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or Google Cloud acceptable) through academic, project, or hands-on experience.
  • Comfort with scripting and automation in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Understanding Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) principles; experience with tools like Terraform is a plus.
  • Basic knowledge of containers and development in Linux-based environments.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proven ability to learn new technologies independently as needed.
  • Willingness to work onsite in a collaborative environment, engaging directly with peers to deliver working solutions quickly.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering, Business or other related field

Preferred Qualifications

You are exactly who we are looking for if you:

  • Experience building or contributing to internal tools, automation frameworks, or developer platforms.
  • Familiarity with container orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) and related concepts like Helm or service meshes.
  • Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and working in compliance-driven environments (e.g., FedRAMP, ITAR, NIST).
  • Demonstrated ability to prototype quickly and iterate using AI-assisted coding workflows.
  • Coursework or certification in cloud architecture, DevOps, or cybersecurity.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or strong personal coding portfolio showcasing full stack or DevOps-related work.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering, Business or other related field

Why Join Exostar?

At Exostar, you’ll step into a global DevOps organization that plays a critical role in delivering secure, cloud-native solutions for industries that matter—Aerospace & Defense, Life Sciences, and other high-stakes sectors. This is more than a job; it’s a launchpad for engineers who want to:

  • Join a global team delivering automation and developer tooling across North America, Europe, and India.
  • Work in a high-impact, hands-on environment where your ideas and code will influence how our software is built and deployed.
  • Collaborate daily with engineers, architects, and SREs to modernize CI/CD pipelines and internal platforms.
  • Leverage cutting-edge AI tools like GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT to accelerate your work and expand your technical capabilities.
  • Gain exposure to real-world cloud operations, security practices, and compliance frameworks early in your career.
  • Work onsite in Cincinnati with peers and technical leaders who value speed, initiative, and practical innovation.

If you're a builder who thrives on learning by doing, this is your opportunity to be part of a mission-driven company pushing the boundaries of modern DevOps.

Exostar’s cloud-based platforms create exclusive communities within the Aerospace and Defense, Life Sciences, and other highly regulated industries where members securely collaborate, share information, and operate compliantly. Within these communities we build trust. By analyzing community data, we provide insights and intelligence, enabling organizations to make better, timelier decisions, to mitigate risk, and operate more efficiently.

  • We believe in employee development: we promote internally and provide training and educational assistance
  • We provide a fun, engaged workplace, with social and community-building events
  • We offer comprehensive benefits and flexible time off plans

Exostar is an Equal Opportunity Employment Employer. The company provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability status or genetic information. Exostar is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all persons in all facets of employment including recruiting, hiring, compensation, promotion, training, benefits, transfers and working conditions.

title: Senior Declassification Programs Lead
description:
Senior Declassification Programs Lead


At B&A, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. B&A believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to B&A, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. Our people are entrepreneurial thinkers that combine mindset, vision, and experience to drive value – not only to us as an organization, but to the clients we support. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients, and with each other, as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love for you to join our team!


Job Summary


The Senior Declassification Programs Lead (MDR & FRUS) provides leadership, oversight, and subject matter expertise for Mandatory Declassification Review (MDR) and Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS) program activities supporting federal national security missions. This position is responsible for managing personnel, directing declassification review operations, developing and implementing declassification policies, and coordinating with Department of Defense (DoD), Department of Energy (DOE), and other federal agencies to ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and executive directives governing classified national security information.


The successful candidate will lead teams responsible for reviewing classified records, resolving complex declassification issues, and ensuring MDR and FRUS activities are conducted efficiently, accurately, and in accordance with Executive Order 13526, DoD information security requirements, and other federal declassification authorities.


Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage personnel supporting MDR, FRUS, and related declassification review programs.
  • Oversee daily operations involving the review, analysis, and processing of classified national security information.
  • Direct the execution of Mandatory Declassification Review (MDR) requests and support Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS) historical review activities.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures, and operational guidance governing declassification programs.
  • Ensure compliance with Executive Order 13526, applicable DoD information security regulations, DOE requirements, the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, and other federal directives governing classified information.
  • Provide subject matter expertise across declassification program areas, including:
  • Mandatory Declassification Review (MDR)
  • Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS)
  • Access to Declassified Records (ADR)
  • Systematic Declassification
  • Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) reviews
  • Security and Classification Reviews
  • Coordinate declassification activities with DOE, DoD, the Department of State, National Archives and Records Administration (NARA), and other federal agencies.
  • Review and evaluate classified records containing Restricted Data (RD) and Formerly Restricted Data (FRD) in coordination with appropriate authorities.
  • Develop recommendations and resolutions for complex classification and declassification issues.
  • Monitor program performance, staffing, workloads, and quality assurance measures to ensure timely and accurate completion of reviews.
  • Prepare reports, status updates, and executive briefings for Government leadership and stakeholders.
  • Support audits, inspections, records management initiatives, and program compliance reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to improve review processes, operational efficiencies, and declassification program effectiveness.

Education and Experience

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience managing personnel, including supervision, workload management, and team leadership.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting Mandatory Declassification Review (MDR) and Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS) programs.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience developing and implementing policies and regulations governing declassification programs, including:
  • MDR
  • FRUS
  • Access to Declassified Records (ADR)
  • Systematic Declassification
  • Freedom of Information Act (FOIA)
  • Security and Classification Reviews

Demonstrated experience applying and interpreting:

  • Executive Order 13526
  • Department of Defense information security regulations
  • Department of Energy security requirements
  • Atomic Energy Act of 1954
  • Restricted Data (RD) and Formerly Restricted Data (FRD) requirements
  • Other federal regulations governing classified national security information


  • Minimum of 3 years of experience coordinating with DOE, DoD, and other federal agencies in the declassification process.
  • Bachelor of Arts (BA) or Bachelor of Science (BS) degree from an accredited institution in any discipline

Required Skills

  • Experience supporting Department of State, DoD, DOE, NARA, or Intelligence Community declassification programs.
  • Experience managing classified historical records review projects.
  • Experience with electronic records review and declassification management systems.
  • Familiarity with archival research, records management, and government disclosure processes.
  • Experience supporting executive-level stakeholders in national security environments.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Expert knowledge of federal declassification policies, procedures, and authorities.
  • Thorough understanding of MDR and FRUS review processes.
  • Strong knowledge of Executive Order 13526 and federal information security requirements.
  • Ability to interpret and apply complex classification and declassification guidance.
  • Excellent leadership, personnel management, and team-building skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
  • Ability to prepare executive-level reports, recommendations, and briefings.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with senior government officials and interagency stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a secure and fast-paced environment.

Security Clearance


Must possess a current, final, and fully adjudicated Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance.


More About B&A:

Notable Clients
B&A has grown to be a company that is trusted by our clients for exceptional service, innovative solutions, and inspired employees. Our service extends through federal, state, and local Government, the private sector, and higher education. Some of our notable clients include Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, U.S. Senate, U.S. Courts, U.S. Census Bureau, U.S. Navy, and more.


Benefits and Programs

B&A is proud to offer three robust individual and family medical plans to full time employees, including a Health Savings Account (HSA) option as well as two tiers of dental coverage, vision, life & AD&D, disability, accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness insurance. In addition to these benefits, B&A employees enjoy paid time off, B&A sponsored trainings and certifications, pet insurance benefits, commuter transit benefits and a free subscription to a virtual exercise platform (NEOU). B&A’s 401(k) plan is available to all employees and includes a company matching contribution.

B&A has launched several programs to focus on employee engagement, wellness, and assistance. These include:

  • The B&A Cares program: 30/60/90-day wellness check ins, personal development, financial management, and stress management seminars, and more
  • A formal mentorship program
  • Job shadowing and cross training opportunities
  • Brand Ambassador program
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access to various support resources to include counseling, legal guidance, financial planning, and more
  • Monthly teambuilding events
  • B&A Annual Wellness Challenges: #StepWithB&A, #WalkDuringLunchWithB&A, #VolunteeringWithB&A, #ExerciseDuringLunchWithB&A, and more

At B&A, we place significant importance on improving the communities and lives of citizens across the nation through our involvement, technology expertise, and employees. B&A puts an emphasis on charitable efforts in the Northern Virginia area, including Capital Area Food Bank pantry drives, book donations, Hope for Henry Foundation events, and many more. In recognition of all these efforts, B&A has been named a Companies as Responsive Employers (CARE) award recipient by Northern Virginia Family Services and nominated by the Northern Virginia Chamber of Commerce for Outstanding Corporate Citizenship Award.

B&A provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. title: Grant Writer
description:
The Grants Officer is responsible for preparing and managing a high volume of competitive grant proposals, reports, and related funding documents that support Family & Children's Services' mission and strategic priorities. This position works collaboratively with programs, finance, compliance, data, and executive leadership to develop compelling funding requests, steward reporting requirements, and communicate program impact to funders.

The Grants Officer serves as a dedicated proposal and reporting resource for the organization’s public and private funding portfolio. Responsibilities include researching and writing grant applications, preparing reports, coordinating submission requirements, and supporting continuous improvement efforts within the Grants Team.

POSITION SPECIFIC DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

General Requirements

  • Write, edit, and prepare competitive grant proposals/applications, reports, letters of inquiry, concept papers, and related funding documents.
  • Collect, analyze, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data to strengthen and complete grant proposals and reports, demonstrate program impact, and complete other funder requirements.
  • Translate complex programmatic, financial, and evaluation information into clear and compelling proposals, reports, and requirements.
  • Manage a portfolio of assigned funders and prospects, leading the planning, coordination, and execution of grant submissions while ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and funder requirements.

Grant Proposal Development

  • Collaborate with program leaders, subject matter experts, finance staff, data team, and leadership to gather and analyze required application content.
  • Prepare application attachments, supporting documentation, and narrative components in accordance with funder guidelines.
  • Develop outcome and impact statements that effectively communicate program success.
  • Maintain proposal templates, boilerplate language, and other grant writing resources.
  • Assist in researching prospective grant opportunities aligned with agency priorities.
  • Ensure proposals accurately reflect organizational priorities, program goals, and funder requirements.

Grant Reporting & Funder Communications

  • Prepare and submit interim, annual, and final grant reports.
  • Collaborate with program leadership, finance, and data team to obtain and analyze data and supporting documentation.
  • Draft impact summaries, outcome narratives, success stories, and stewardship communications for funders.
  • Monitor reporting requirements and deadlines to ensure compliance.

Project Management & Compliance

  • Track assigned proposal and reporting deadlines to ensure timely submission.
  • Maintain accurate records of grant requirements, submissions, and outcomes.
  • Adhere to established Grants Team processes, procedures, and quality standards.
  • Assist with maintaining grant compliance documentation and audit-ready records.
  • Support internal review and approval workflows.
  • Ensure all submissions are complete, accurate, and compliant with funder instructions.

Team Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in Grants Team planning meetings and workflow coordination.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to identify and implement process improvements.
  • Maintain familiarity with agency programs, strategic priorities, and funding needs.
  • Contribute to shared knowledge resources, templates, and best practices.
  • Provide writing, editing, and proofreading support for grant-related projects and special initiatives as assigned.
  • Maintain professional knowledge through training, webinars, professional associations, and self-directed learning.

QUALIFICATIONS

education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, Journalism, Public Administration, Nonprofit Management, Business, Social Work, Psychology, Sociology, Education, or a related field is required.
  • Master's degree preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • Five (5) years of experience in grant writing, proposal development, and/or grants management.
  • Demonstrated experience developing successful grant proposals and reports.
  • Experience with government, foundation, and corporate grant applications preferred.
  • Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, human services, education, or nonprofit organizations preferred.
  • Certified Fund Raising Executive (CFRE), Grant Professional Certification (GPC), or other grant-related designation preferred.

PERFORMANCE COMPETENCIES:

  • Communication
  • Decision Making
  • Engagement
  • Initiative and Accountability
  • Interpersonal
  • Learning
  • Organizational Alignment
  • Quality of Work

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  • Exceptional writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills.
  • Strong ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
  • Ability to synthesize information from multiple stakeholders into a cohesive narrative.
  • Excellent research and analytical skills.
  • Strong organizational and project management abilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Experience using databases, grant management systems, SharePoint, or CRM platforms preferred.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as a team member.
  • Ability to establish collaborative working relationships with staff at all organizational levels.
  • Commitment to accuracy, accountability, continuous learning, and professional growth.
  • Strong alignment with the mission, values, and goals of Family & Children's Services.

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES:

  • N/A

OTHER INFORMATION

SAFETY SENSITIVE JOB CLASSIFICATION:

This job is classified as a “safety-sensitive” position as defined by the Oklahoma Medical Marijuana and Patient Protection Act. Due to the “safety-sensitive” classification, an employee in this position would be subject to drug and alcohol testing, including random testing. Marijuana is one of the substances included in the drug panel screening. Possession of a medical marijuana license will not excuse you from the testing process or the consequences of testing positive for marijuana per the Family & Children’s Services Drug Free Workplace Policy, including possible revocation of a job offer or dismissal from employment.

title: Applied Epic Manager/System Administrator
description:
This role must be within driving distance to the Indianapolis corporate office. The work schedule is hybrid, and employees are required to be onsite at least 3 days per week.


The Applied Epic Manager serves as the company-wide owner and primary subject matter expert for Gregory & Appel’s Applied Epic platform. This role extends well beyond traditional system administration. This role is accountable for the governance, integrity, configuration, optimization, and continued evolution of the system to ensure Epic remains a reliable source of information and effectively supports firm operations, client service, financial processes, reporting, and future growth.

Operating as an enterprise business systems leader, the Applied Epic Manager owns the ongoing system roadmap, data governance, change management, testing, release coordination, workflow configuration, integrations, and adoption of new functionality.


The Applied Epic Manager partners closely with Operations, Accounting, Revenue and Marketing, IT, and firm leadership to translate business needs into scalable system solutions, maintain standardized processes, and ensure Gregory & Appel continues to realize the value of its investment in Applied Epic.


Success in this role requires balancing strong system expertise with an enterprise mindset. The Applied Epic Manager is responsible for protecting the integrity of established workflows and data standards while continuously identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve adoption, increase automation, strengthen reporting, and optimize how the organization uses the platform.


Essential job duties include but are not limited to:

  • Serve as the company-wide owner and primary subject matter expert for Applied Epic, maintaining accountability for the overall health, functionality, governance, and continued development of the platform.
  • Own and maintain the Applied Epic roadmap, identifying and prioritizing system enhancements, new functionality, automation opportunities, and other improvements based on organizational needs and business value.
  • Establish and maintain governance standards for system configuration, workflows, data, documentation, reporting, security, and system usage across the organization.
  • Administer and maintain Epic configuration, including workflows, activities, templates, forms, document management, automation, dashboards, security roles, permissions, and other system functionality.
  • Establish and maintain change-control processes for material system configuration, workflow, security, data, reporting, and integration changes.
  • Evaluate business requests and translate operational needs into sustainable, scalable Epic solutions while avoiding unnecessary customization, duplicate processes, and departmental workarounds.
  • Maintain alignment between Epic workflows and Gregory & Appel’s established operating model, partnering with business leaders to identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish and oversee company-wide data governance standards, including required fields, data definitions, naming conventions, documentation requirements, ownership expectations, and other controls necessary to maintain reliable data.
  • Partner with business leaders to establish clear accountability for the accuracy, completeness, and maintenance of data within their areas of responsibility.
  • Monitor data quality and lead recurring audits, cleanup efforts, and remediation initiatives to address incomplete, inaccurate, inconsistent, or duplicate information.
  • Maintain the integrity of client, policy, carrier, producer, accounting, revenue, and other key data maintained within Applied Epic.
  • Ensure Epic data and system structures support reliable reporting, analytics, automation, integrations, compliance requirements, and informed business decision-making.
  • Own the evaluation, testing, coordination, and implementation of Applied Epic releases, upgrades, enhancements, and new functionality.
  • Remain current on Applied Epic releases and capabilities and proactively evaluate new functionality for potential value to the organization.
  • Develop testing requirements and coordinate user acceptance testing with appropriate business subject matter experts before significant system changes are moved into production.
  • Develop and coordinate rollout plans for system changes and new functionality, including implementation timing, communication, documentation, training requirements, and post-implementation support.
  • Monitor implementation results and user adoption following system changes and make adjustments as necessary.
  • Partner with Operations leadership, subject matter experts, and other internal resources to ensure training materials, workflow documentation, job aids, and onboarding content accurately reflect current Epic functionality and approved business processes.
  • Collaborate on role-based training associated with new features, workflow changes, and system enhancements.
  • Identify recurring user issues that may indicate the need for additional training, workflow clarification, system enhancement, or greater accountability.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and support for complex Epic issues, focusing on root-cause resolution rather than creating long-term workarounds.
  • Build, support, and improve Epic reports and dashboards to support operational, financial, compliance, performance, and leadership reporting needs.
  • Establish governance around report definitions, data sources, and system-driven KPIs to promote consistency and confidence in agency reporting.
  • Partner with leadership and business owners to translate reporting and measurement needs into sustainable system solutions.
  • Own the functional oversight of integrations between Applied Epic and other agency technology platforms.
  • Partner with IT, Applied Systems, and third-party vendors to troubleshoot system issues, maintain integrations, evaluate solutions, and coordinate system-related projects.
  • Evaluate the downstream impact of configuration, workflow, and data changes on integrations, reporting, accounting, and other business processes prior to implementation.
  • Support system conversions, acquisitions, book rolls, data migrations, and other significant initiatives involving Applied Epic.
  • Maintain appropriate system documentation, including configuration standards, governance decisions, workflow requirements, testing results, change history, and other key system information.
  • Support system controls, audit readiness, regulatory requirements, carrier requirements, and E&O risk mitigation through disciplined system and data governance.
  • Promote consistent and disciplined use of Applied Epic across the organization and reinforce established standards as business needs evolve.
  • Continually identify opportunities to increase the value Gregory & Appel receives from Applied Epic through improved functionality, automation, reporting, data quality, and user adoption.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

title: Agile Product Manager Senior Advisor, Individual Dental - Cigna Healthcare  - Re
description:
Role Summary

The Product Manager is accountable for ensuring that the product team solves meaningful customer problems in ways that deliver measurable business value. Rather than acting primarily as a project coordinator, requirements writer, or backlog administrator, the Product Manager leads through customer insight, product strategy, evidence-based decision-making, and close collaboration with design, engineering, data, operations, and business partners.

The Product Manager works as part of a durable, cross-functional product team that is given important problems to solve - not predetermined features to deliver. The team is measured by customer and business outcomes rather than output, activity, or adherence to an original project plan.

The Product Manager is accountable for product value and business viability, while partnering with design and engineering to address usability and feasibility. Together, the team discovers, delivers, measures, and continuously improves solutions that customers value and that work within the organization’s strategic, financial, operational, legal, regulatory, security, and technology constraints.

The Product Manager also connects strategy and customer journeys across a broader product ecosystem, identifies opportunities for shared capabilities and reuse, and applies artificial intelligence to improve customer value, learning speed, decision quality, and product team efficiency

What You Will Own

Product Vision, Strategy, and Outcomes

  • Develop and communicate a compelling product vision aligned with enterprise strategy, customer needs, and measurable business objectives.
  • Translate strategic priorities into clearly defined customer or business problems for the product team to solve.
  • Establish outcome-based product goals, success measures, guardrails, and leading indicators.
  • Maintain an outcome-oriented roadmap that communicates strategic intent, learning priorities, and anticipated customer or business impact - not merely a schedule of features.
  • Make evidence-based product decisions using customer insights, product analytics, operational data, market information, and business performance.
  • Evaluate progress against outcomes and recommend whether to continue, adjust, scale, or stop an investment.
  • Balance near-term opportunities with long-term product health, scalability, sustainability, and strategic differentiation.

Customer and Market Understanding

  • Develop deep knowledge of customers, users, buyers, stakeholders, and the environments in which they use the product.
  • Conduct and participate in customer interviews, observation, usability testing, journey analysis, and other forms of qualitative research.
  • Use quantitative data to understand customer behavior, adoption, performance, unmet needs, and friction points.
  • Monitor relevant market developments, industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive alternatives.
  • Clearly articulate the customer problem, its significance, the affected customer segments, and the expected impact of solving it.
  • Maintain regular customer contact so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than assumptions or stakeholder preference.

Continuous Product Discovery

  • Lead continuous discovery in close partnership with product design and engineering.
  • Frame opportunities as testable product hypotheses.
  • Explore multiple solution approaches before committing significant delivery capacity.
  • Identify and evaluate the primary product risks: value, viability, usability, and feasibility.
  • Use prototypes, experiments, technical spikes, customer testing, analytics, and other appropriate techniques to test assumptions early.
  • Synthesize discovery evidence and make clear recommendations about which opportunities and solutions should advance.
  • Ensure ideas are validated sufficiently before the organization makes material delivery investments.

Product Delivery and Lifecycle Ownership

  • Partner with engineering, design, Product Owners, architecture, data, operations, and other contributors to translate validated opportunities into incremental product releases.
  • Provide strategic context and timely product decisions without prescribing how specialists should perform their work.
  • Prioritize opportunities and product investments based on expected outcomes, customer impact, evidence, risk, effort, and strategic alignment.
  • Make informed trade-offs involving scope, timing, quality, customer experience, operational readiness, and business value.
  • Maintain alignment between the product strategy, roadmap, discovery pipeline, and delivery backlog.
  • Enable frequent delivery of small increments so the team can gather customer feedback, measure results, and adapt quickly.
  • Participate actively in planning, reviews, demonstrations, and other team activities where product context or decisions are needed.
  • Remain accountable after launch by monitoring adoption, customer behavior, reliability, operational performance, and business results.
  • Partner with the team to resolve production issues, improve product health, address technical debt, and optimize the product throughout its lifecycle.

Business Viability and Enterprise Partnership

  • Understand the organization’s business model, strategic objectives, financial considerations, operating processes, customer commitments, and regulatory environment.
  • Identify constraints involving compliance, privacy, legal, security, finance, sales, service, operations, and other enterprise functions.
  • Engage these partners early enough to inform discovery rather than treating them only as downstream approvers.
  • Build alignment through customer evidence, data, options, transparent trade-offs, and clearly stated product outcomes.
  • Influence senior leaders and stakeholders without becoming an order-taker for individual feature requests.
  • Communicate product strategy, decisions, risks, learning, progress, and results in language appropriate for executive, business, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Proactively manage cross-product dependencies and escalate only those decisions that cannot be resolved within the empowered team.

Team Collaboration and Product Culture

  • Operate as a peer within the product team, recognizing that innovation results from the combined expertise and ideas of product, design, engineering, data, and operational partners.
  • Provide the team with meaningful context, customer access, clear outcomes, and decision-making guardrails.
  • Promote healthy debate, rapid learning, respectful challenge, and shared accountability.
  • Encourage experimentation while ensuring experiments are ethical, secure, measurable, and appropriate for the business environment.
  • Model curiosity, humility, transparency, inclusion, and a willingness to change direction when evidence challenges an existing assumption.
  • Help the organization continue its transition from project delivery and feature output toward durable teams, continuous learning, and outcome ownership.

AI-Enabled Product Management

  • Leverage AI to accelerate customer understanding, product discovery, analysis, and decision-making.
  • Increase product team effectiveness through AI-enabled workflows, automation, and knowledge management.
  • Apply AI responsibly to improve customer experiences, business outcomes, and operational efficiency.
  • Define and measure outcomes for AI-enabled capabilities and ways of working.
  • Maintain appropriate human judgment, accountability, transparency, and governance in AI-supported decisions.
  • Identify opportunities where AI can create meaningful customer, business, or employee value.

What Success Looks Like

  • The team understands the customer problem, strategic context, intended outcome, and measures of success.
  • Product decisions are supported by customer evidence, product data, and business understanding.
  • The team tests its most significant assumptions before committing substantial delivery effort.
  • Roadmaps communicate problems, goals, outcomes, and learning - not just feature dates.
  • Customers adopt and benefit from released solutions.
  • Product investments produce measurable customer, business, operational, or strategic results.
  • The team learns quickly, delivers incrementally, and changes direction when evidence warrants it.
  • Stakeholders understand product decisions and trade-offs, even when their requested features are not selected.
  • The product remains reliable, supportable, compliant, secure, and sustainable after launch.
  • Low-value work is stopped, and capacity is redirected toward higher-impact opportunities.
  • AI-enabled product practices shorten learning and decision cycles while preserving customer evidence, accountable judgment, and responsible governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of product management, digital product, technology product, or comparable experience.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a technology-enabled product or significant product area through discovery, delivery, launch, measurement, and optimization.
  • Experience working with cross-functional partners such as engineering, design, data, architecture, operations, marketing, service, legal, compliance, or finance.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify customer problems and convert insights into product strategy and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience using qualitative research and quantitative data to make decisions.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and structured problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, reconcile competing needs, and make sound decisions with incomplete information.
  • Strong written, verbal, facilitation, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Working knowledge of modern software development, Agile delivery, product analytics, experimentation, and product discovery practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries without relying solely on positional authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within a regulated, complex, or highly matrixed enterprise environment.
  • Experience with empowered product teams, continuous discovery, dual-track product development, or outcome-based roadmaps.
  • Familiarity with product discovery techniques such as customer interviewing, prototyping, usability testing, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, and opportunity-solution mapping.
  • Experience defining product objectives, key results, guardrail metrics, and product performance dashboards.
  • Understanding of software architecture, APIs, data platforms, cloud technologies, automation, artificial intelligence, or other relevant emerging technologies.
  • Agile or product management certification is helpful but is not a substitute for demonstrated product judgment and results.
  • Experience with product and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, product analytics platforms, research repositories, or visual collaboration tools.
  • Familiarity with generative AI, machine learning product patterns, AI evaluation, responsible AI practices, model or data risk, and human-centered AI design.
  • Experience applying AI-enabled tools to improve product discovery, analysis, documentation, decision support, or operating efficiency.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Welcome to the future of cloud networking and security!

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

We seek an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our team in Prague, Czech Republic. In this key role, you will develop cloud-based networking and security management solutions, working on new products and features that directly impact our customers. You will also be responsible for building microservices in near real-time environments as part of a dynamic scrum team.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Software Development: Implement scalable, stable, and secure coding patterns. Develop high-scale microservices with near real-time performance and contribute to Cato’s web application through backend and full-stack development.
  • Code Reviews: Ensure quality, test coverage, and security in code reviews.
  • Technical Specifications: Understand the architecture and connected features of solutions. Architect end-to-end solutions for complex features, document trade-offs, and provide feedback on specifications.
  • Support/On-Call Rotation: Respond to outage incidents and troubleshoot security issues.

Technology Stack:
  • Java, Spring Boot
  • AWS (SQS, KMS, DocDB, S3), Microservices, Kubernetes, Docker, Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
  • Golang, TypeScript, React

Requirements:
  • 5+ years of backend development experience with proficiency in Java and Spring Boot.
  • Proven experience in high-performance environments and benchmark evaluation.
  • Expertise in architecture, design, and development of complex web applications.
  • Experience with microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, Grafana is a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with SaaS/Cloud-based infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) is an advantage.
  • Experience with web development using Go and GraphQL is a plus.
  • Strong team player with excellent collaboration skills.
  • Self-learner with the ability to acquire new skills and technologies quickly.
  • Motivated, fast learner, independent, and adept at problem-solving.
  • BSc in Computer Science from a recognized university.

Dev Lifecycle:
You’ll receive spec definitions from Product Management, you’ll review the spec and work on a suitable design, and once ready you’ll conduct a Design Review meeting.
Having the design approved, you’ll write great code, build and deploy your artifact to k8s, and test it.
You’ll make sure the feature can be monitored, having metrics and alerts defined.

About App Security Group:
This group provides security & visibility for SaaS applications being used by organizations (i.e. used by Cato’s customers).
We are doing it by integrating with these 3rd party vendors ( like Salesforce, Slack, ServiceNow, Dropbox etc.) using their public APIs, fetching data on various activities (sign-ins, sharing, exporting etc.) and bringing it into Cato platform, enforcing relevant security policy in supported apps.
We’re expanding our capabilities by designing & building an infrastructure that will allow us to accommodate a large scale of applications and support additional use cases brought up by Cato’s product team.

*We operate in a hybrid model, requiring three days in the office.
*Location: NR7, Náměstí republiky, Prague, Czech Republic.

At Houston Methodist, the Pharmacy Clinical Specialist position is responsible for performing advanced clinical pharmacy duties, enabling the delivery of optimal pharmacotherapy to patients and facilitating safe, efficacious, and pharmacoeconomically rational use of medications in the population(s) served. This position involves daily reactive and targeted proactive medication regimen reviews for patients within the designated area(s) of responsibility or populations served. The Pharmacy Clinical Specialist position supports the delivery of pharmacy managed protocols, formulary processes, and medication reconciliation activities while providing education to fellow pharmacists, nurses, and medical staff. Additional duties for this position include precepting pharmacy students and pharmacy residents on clinical patient care rotations within areas of responsibility and contributing to fulfilling the organization's mission to provide innovative, personalized, cost-effective pharmaceutical care in a culture dedicated to quality and safety.

FLSA STATUS

EXPERIENCE

  • Meets HM standards of an ASHP-Qualified Residency Preceptor within one year of employment

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS
Required

Preferred
  • IV Certification - Intravenous certification (Various) or

KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES

PEOPLE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Exercises good judgment in patient care decisions per performance standard and documents patient care activities and patient outcomes impacted by pharmaceutical care and clinical interventions.
  • Provides patient-specific and non-patient specific drug information support regularly.

title: Områdeleder til mobil- og utrykningstjeneste - Asker & Bærum
description:
Vi søker nå etter en imøtekommende, handlekraftig og selvgående områdeleder til mobil- og utrykningsavdelingen vår i Asker. Arbeidstiden vil primært være dagtid, men arbeid utenfor normal kontortid vil måtte påregnes ved behov.

Som områdeleder vil du ha ansvar for organiseringen, oppfølgingen og kvalitetssikringen av tjenesteleveransen ut mot kundene våre. Stillingen innebærer operativ tjeneste som mobilvekter, men også administrative oppgaver knyttet til oppfølging av kunder og medarbeidere.

Høres dette ut som deg? Da er det nettopp deg vi har lyst til å komme i prat med.

Arbeidsoppgaver er blant annet

  • Operativt og administrativt lederansvar: Organisering, oppfølging og kvalitetssikring av tjenesteleveransen
  • Alarmutrykning og beredskap
  • Opplæring og oppfølging av vekterne tilknyttet eget ansvarsområde
  • Planlegging og oppstart av nye oppdrag
  • Planlegging og avslutning av oppdrag/kunder som faller bort
  • Bistå med planlegging og bemanning av personell
  • Utarbeide og revidere instruksverk og rutiner i samarbeid med kundene våre
  • Være bindeledd mellom vektere, kunden og lokal administrasjon
  • Bistå øvrige mobil- og utrykningsruter ved behov
  • Kundeoppfølging
  • Nøkkel- og kortadministrasjon for avdelingens kunder
  • Kjøretøy og utstyrsansvarlig

Oversikten er ikke uttømmende, og det vil også være arbeidsoppgaver som ikke er nevnt over og som vil være en naturlig del av arbeidsdagen.

Hvem ser vi etter

  • Vi ser etter deg som er opptatt av sikkerhet og har et ønske om å utvikle deg som leder. For å lykkes som områdeleder i utrykningstjenesten i Asker og Bærum er det viktig at du kjenner deg igjen i flere av disse karakteristikkene:
  • Evner å se løsninger på enkle og kompliserte problemstillinger. Teoretiske så vel som praktiske problemer
  • Evner å ta selvstendige beslutninger. - Evner å spille dine kollegaer gode, bygge tillit og skape rom for utvikling
  • Kommunisere på en klar og tydelig måte og gjøre deg forstått hos ulike mennesketyper
  • Du må ha en særlig god strukturert og ryddig arbeidsmetodikk, og god forståelse og bruk av MS Excel.
  • Du har stor gjennomføringsevne
  • Er empatisk, imøtekommende og trygg på egen person
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • God fysisk og psykisk helse
  • God teknisk forståelse/datakunnskap
  • Beherske norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Erfaring som vekter er et krav, og om du har ledererfaring i tillegg vil være en fordel
  • Erfaring fra mobil- og utrykningstjeneste er en klar og stor fordel, men ingen krav.
  • Komfortabel med å benytte PC som arbeidsverktøy i tillegg til andre digitale plattformer som benyttes i Securitas.
  • Tilfredsstillende vandel (jf. Lov om Vaktvirksomhet)
  • Må kunne sikkerhetsklareres iht. nasjonale nivåer opp til STRENGT HEMMELIG
  • Bestått godkjent Vekterutdanning (jf. Lov om Vaktvirksomhet). Securitas vil for rett kandidat bistå med dette

Som vekter i Securitas tilbyr vi en profesjonell og lærerik arbeidsplass, med personlig utviklings- og karrieremuligheter. Lønn er iht. tariff, og du kan lese mer i Vekteroverkomsten her.

Dersom du tenker at dette passer perfekt for deg, vil vi gjerne at du registrerer din søknad allerede i dag! Søknader blir behandlet fortløpende.

title: Software Principal Engineer
description:
Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.

DataPath Engineering - Dell Technologies, Israel
The Software Engineering team delivers next-generation application enhancements and new products for a changing world. Working at the cutting edge, we design and develop the software powering Dell's enterprise storage products as part of the Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) - spanning platforms, applications and diagnostics, all with the most advanced technologies, tools, software engineering methodologies and the collaboration of internal and external partners.
Our DataPath Engineering team builds the high-performance storage software stack at the heart of Dell’s primary storage platforms - much of it built on and contributed back to open source, including the Storage Performance Development Kit (SPDK).
Join us as a Software Principal Engineer on our engineering team in Israel to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact.
We work in an AI-native development environment - applying spec-driven development (SDD) and clear engineering governance to deliver complex software with both speed and without sacrificing quality.

Key Responsibilities
As a Principal Software Engineer, you will:

  • Design, develop, and own complex software features - from requirements and design through implementation, testing, and long-term support.
  • Build high-performance datapath software on SPDK, integrating emerging drive, enclosure, and protocol technologies.
  • Own performance analysis of the storage software data path - including queueing behavior, CPU efficiency, memory usage, PCIe bottlenecks, and latency behavior.
  • Work closely with architecture, hardware, and software teams on HW/SW interface definition.
  • Experiment with and integrate emerging AI tools into the development workflow to boost productivity and innovation.

Essential Requirements

  • Relevant BSc with exceptional marks from a top university.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience with one or more of: storage, device drivers, embedded software/firmware, Linux, networking, including a proven track record of contributing to open-source projects and engaging with upstream communities.
  • Expert-level coding skills in C/C++.
  • Experience and understanding of Linux internals including algorithms, data structures, multithreading concepts, object synchronization and communication protocols.
  • Comfort working in an AI-native development environment - spec-driven development (SDD), AI-assisted workflows, and engineering governance.

Desirable Requirements

  • Deep experience with NVMe-oF, storage networking, or low-latency distributed systems, including hands-on familiarity with NVMe SSD internals and an understanding of how device-level features impact host-side performance.
  • Working knowledge of storage and networking protocols and related high-performance transports (RDMA/RoCE), along with experience using Python for infrastructure tooling, test automation, and scripting.

title: Data Scientist  (3651)
description:
Data Scientist (3651) - Monument Place

Data Scientist
Location: Hybrid, Monument Place
Reporting to: Insights Lead

Help Shape the Future of Data-Driven Decision Making at GTR

Are you passionate about turning complex data into meaningful insight that drives real-world outcomes?

At GTR, we're looking for an ambitious and forward-thinking Data Scientist to help us unlock the power of data, machine learning and advanced analytics across one of the UK's largest train operating companies.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in establishing GTR's first in-house machine learning capability, helping us better understand future risks, opportunities and operational outcomes. You'll work at the heart of our Data & AI function, developing predictive models that support smarter decision making, improve performance and create tangible value for our customers and business.

About the Role

As a Data Scientist in the Central Data & Ai function, you will use advanced analytics, statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to extract forward-looking insights from large and complex datasets across multiple business domains.

Working closely with operational and business stakeholders, you'll help define business problems, test hypotheses and develop predictive and prescriptive models that influence decision making across commercial, operational and safety functions.

This role offers the opportunity to work within a modern enterprise data environment, leveraging over 40 DataHub products that support more than 2,000 active users. As GTR continues to expand its data and AI capabilities, you'll play an important role in shaping standards, approaches and best practices for data science across the organisation.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Developing predictive and prescriptive models using curated DataHub datasets.
  • Applying statistical and machine learning techniques to identify trends, risks and future outcomes.
  • Working with stakeholders to frame business challenges, define hypotheses and design effective interventions.
  • Translating complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Explaining model assumptions, limitations and risks to support informed decision making.
  • Collaborating with Data Engineers to develop data models that support analytical and machine learning use cases.
  • Monitoring, evaluating and improving model performance as business conditions evolve.
  • Contributing to the development of data science standards, governance and best practice across GTR.
  • Supporting the responsible adoption of AI and advanced analytics within an enterprise environment.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a curious and commercially aware Data Scientist who combines strong technical expertise with excellent stakeholder engagement skills.

You Will Bring:

  • Demonstrable experience delivering end-to-end data science solutions in a business environment.
  • Strong knowledge of statistical modelling, machine learning and predictive analytics techniques.
  • Advanced Python and SQL skills, with experience building scalable analytical solutions for production environments.
  • Experience designing, training, validating and deploying machine learning models.
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate complex business challenges into structured analytical approaches.
  • Experience working with large enterprise datasets and integrating multiple data sources to generate actionable insight.
  • Strong data visualisation and storytelling skills, ideally using Power BI or similar tools.
  • Experience working within cloud-based analytics platforms, ideally Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Databricks, Synapse or similar technologies.
  • The ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels.
  • A collaborative mindset with the confidence to challenge assumptions and propose innovative solutions.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of data science and AI at GTR.

You'll work on meaningful challenges that directly influence how one of the UK's largest train operating companies serves its customers, manages risk and improves performance. You'll have the chance to build innovative solutions at scale, work with modern technologies and collaborate with colleagues across the business to create lasting impact.

Our culture is built around being Fair, Accountable, Collaborative, Transparent and Open-Minded, while ensuring everyone feels Valued, Respected and Safe. We believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes and we're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're passionate about using data science, analytics and machine learning to solve complex business challenges and shape better outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

Join us and help build the future of data-driven decision making at GTR.

Please note that we reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date if we receive a high volume of suitable applications.

title: Legacy System Export Developer, PeopleSoft and Oracle EBS
description:
Job Title: Legacy System Export Developer, PeopleSoft and Oracle EBSJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

CACI is seeking a Senior Consultant (Legacy System Export Developer for PeopleSoft and Oracle E‑Business Suite HCM) to support a large federal HCM modernization initiative. You will help migrate federal civilian employee records from legacy HR systems into Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM across multiple agencies. This is a remote role with limited travel and high impact on mission outcomes. You will own extraction, validation, and transformation of HR data; map legacy schemas to Oracle Fusion HCM Data Loader formats; and ensure all extracts meet EHRI standards and data quality thresholds needed for successful migration.

Responsibilities

  • Develop SQL and PL/SQL extraction programs to export employee data from PeopleSoft HRMS and Oracle EBS HCM databases, covering personal data, job history, compensation, benefits, positions, and organizational structures.

  • Analyze agency‑specific configurations and custom fields; produce comprehensive mapping from legacy schemas to Oracle Fusion HCM HDL file formats.

  • Build PeopleSoft Application Designer and Application Engine processes that deliver automated, repeatable extraction routines supporting iterative mock migrations and final cutover.

  • Develop Oracle EBS concurrent programs and extraction packages to ensure complete export of HR, payroll, and benefits data.

  • Create SQR reports and validation queries to verify extraction completeness, integrity, and EHRI compliance prior to ETL handoff.

  • Design and execute data profiling to identify data quality issues, orphaned records, incomplete fields, and customizations that require special treatment.

  • Maintain PeopleSoft and EBS legacy environments used for extraction development and testing, including schema refreshes, access management, and performance tuning for large‑volume exports.

  • Collaborate with agency legacy system administrators to understand custom configurations, interfaces, and dependencies that influence extraction scope and sequencing.

  • Develop reconciliation procedures comparing legacy record counts and key elements to extraction outputs to ensure zero data loss.

  • Document extraction procedures, mapping specifications, and known data quality issues per SAFe Agile artifact standards.

  • Support cutover activities during go‑live events, executing final extraction runs, validating outputs, and resolving extraction issues within tight windows.

  • Apply established methods and standards to independently resolve functional and technical issues of moderate scope; consult senior staff on complex or unfamiliar problems.

  • Communicate clearly with project team members and stakeholders to report progress, explain technical approaches, and support collaborative problem solving across Agile Release Train ceremonies.

Qualifications — Required

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of relevant experience (additional experience may substitute for degree).

  • 5 or more years of experience in database development, data extraction, or database administration for enterprise HR systems.

  • 3 or more years of hands‑on experience with PeopleSoft HRMS (Application Designer, Application Engine, PeopleCode, SQR) and/or Oracle E‑Business Suite HCM (concurrent programs, PL/SQL packages, HR module tables).

  • Strong SQL and PL/SQL development skills; experience writing complex extraction queries against large HR databases with more than 100,000 records.

  • Experience mapping legacy HR schemas to target system formats for migration projects.

  • Knowledge of HR data domains including demographics, job history, position management, compensation, and benefits.

  • Experience with data validation, profiling, and data quality assessment.

  • Familiarity with Agile and SAFe methodologies and iterative migration approaches, including mock conversion cycles.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (U.S. Citizenship required).

Qualifications — Desired

  • 7 or more years of experience in legacy HR system data extraction and migration, with specific experience on federal HR system modernization projects.

  • PeopleSoft tools and technology expertise (PeopleTools 8.5x, Application Engine, Component Interface, Integration Broker).

  • Oracle DBA certification (Oracle Certified Professional).

  • Direct experience with EHRI data standards and federal personnel data reporting requirements.

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion HCM Data Loader and HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader file specifications.

  • Knowledge of federal HR data elements including Nature of Action codes, Standard Form 50 data, and position classification structures.

  • Experience delivering large‑scale migrations of 500,000 or more employee records across varied source systems.

  • Experience with Oracle Cloud technologies such as Oracle Integration Cloud and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in enterprise HCM or ERP environments.

Work Location and Travel

Primarily remote; up to 10 percent travel for agency‑by‑agency migration support during the contract period.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
